title: We Build Progress - Communications Director
description:
**Position Description**


We Build Progress, a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization, and the Progressive Caucus Action Fund (PCAF), a distinct 501(c)(4\) organization, are seeking a **Communications Director** to lead communications and audience engagement strategies for both organizations. The Director will strengthen the organizations’ distinct brands, increase their reach and influence, and clearly communicate their work and unique value to partners, funders, policymakers, advocates, and other key audiences.


The Communications Director will oversee digital communications, content and channel strategy, messaging, executive communications, selective media engagement, and communications planning for major organizational initiatives and events. Working closely with communications, leadership, program, and development staff, the Director will guide the organizations’ communications strategies, shape the organizations’ external voice, identify opportunities to advance their policy and organizational priorities, and advise on reputational and communication risks.


This position requires a strategic leader who is comfortable operating in a hands\-on communications environment. The Director will advise leadership and partner with program staff to integrate communications strategy into the development of program initiatives, publications, partnerships, and events. The ideal candidate has excellent judgment and political acumen, can translate complex policy issues into compelling content, and can build the systems and cross\-functional relationships necessary to execute high\-quality communications across two distinct organizations. The candidate will understand the rapidly changing communications environment and be familiar with progressive narratives and emerging methods used to reach key organizational audiences.


The Communications Director will be employed by We Build Progress and will support the work of both We Build Progress and PCAF pursuant to the organizations’ cost\-sharing agreement. The Communications Director will supervise the Digital \& Content Communications Specialist and report to the Chief Development Officer as part of the Development and External Affairs function.

**Organizational Context and Near\-Term Priorities**


In 2025, the Congressional Progressive Caucus Center became We Build Progress, introducing a new organizational name and brand intended to better reflect the organization’s mission, work, and broader community. The incoming Communications Director will play a central role in continuing to establish the We Build Progress brand, increasing awareness and understanding of the organization, and clearly distinguishing and positioning both We Build Progress and PCAF for their respective audiences.

**Primary Responsibilities**


The Communications Director is responsible for the following areas:

**Communications Strategy, Brand, and Content**

* Develop and oversee an integrated communications strategy, editorial calendar, channel strategy, and cross\-functional processes for planning, producing, reviewing, and distributing content.
* Maintain clear and distinct communications strategies, voices, and identities for We Build Progress and PCAF while identifying appropriate opportunities for alignment and shared storytelling.
* Lead the organizations’ external messaging and brand strategy, ensuring consistency of messaging and voice across all channels.
* Develop communications plans for major organizational initiatives, campaigns, policy priorities, and key announcements.
* Develop and implement strategies to expand the reach and impact of organizational communications assets, including the Unrig the Rules newsletter, DCDownload, briefings, publications, toolkits, events, and other current or future products and channels.
* Partner with program and organizational leaders to incorporate a communications lens into the development of program and policy initiatives, product development, event design, and other organizational priorities, ensuring communications strategies are embedded throughout planning and execution.
* Provide guidance and oversight for priority written, visual, and multimedia content to ensure accuracy, quality, accessibility, and alignment with organizational voice and priorities.

**Development and Audience Engagement**

* Partner closely with Development staff to produce donor and funder communications, grassroots fundraising campaigns, sponsorship materials, annual reports, and other collateral that advances fundraising and engagement goals.
* Develop and implement strategies to grow, segment, and meaningfully engage the organizations’ audiences across email, social media, events, and other communications channels.
* Develop engagement strategies and opportunities that deepen relationships with partners, funders, advocates, policy makers, and other priority audiences.
* Coordinate with staff and external partners to produce timely, strategic, and engaging content for email subscribers and other organizational audiences.
* Develop and implement strategies to grow the organizations’ small dollar donor base via our email campaigns.
* Manage the production of annual reports and other flagship communications products for We Build Progress and PCAF.

**Executive and Event Communications**

* Support the development of messaging, talking points, briefing materials, speeches, presentations, and other communications materials for organizational leadership.
* Lead communications planning for organization\-hosted events, advising on programming, messaging, promotional and conference materials, media engagement, and audience experience.
* Develop timely communications resources and promotional materials that enable speakers, partners, and staff to amplify organizational messages before, during, and after events.
* Coordinate content capture at conferences and events to maximize storytelling and audience engagement opportunities across communications channels.

**Media Relations and External Partnerships**

* Develop and execute proactive media strategies that elevate the organizations’ work, policy priorities, experts, and events.
* Cultivate and maintain relationships with reporters, editors, producers, podcasters, content creators, messaging experts, and other external communicators.
* Draft and distribute press materials, pitch stories and organizational experts, manage incoming media inquiries, and prepare staff and organizational leaders for interviews.
* Identify and pursue opportunities to elevate the organizations’ profiles through podcasts, conferences, speaking engagements, earned media, partnerships, and other external platforms.
* Monitor relevant media coverage and public conversations to identify emerging communications opportunities, reputational risks, and rapid\-response needs.
* Develop and maintain crisis communications plans, protocols, and messaging to ensure the organizations are prepared to respond quickly and effectively to reputational, operational, or policy\-related issues.

**Team and Vendor Management**

* Supervise the Digital \& Content Communications Specialist, providing clear expectations, ongoing coaching, professional development, and effective performance management.
* Establish workflows, roles, and decision\-making processes for communications work across teams.
* Manage communications vendors and consultants, including scopes of work, contracts, budgets, deliverables, and project oversight.

**Measurement and Learning**

* Establish communications goals and performance indicators and regularly assess audience growth, engagement, media reach, content performance, and other relevant measures.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights to refine communications strategies, channels, content, and audience\-engagement efforts.
* Stay informed about evolving communications practices, tools, digital platforms, and audience engagement strategies, and recommend improvements that strengthen organizational communications.
* Provide regular reporting to leadership and staff on communications performance, emerging opportunities, and areas for improvement.


Performs other duties as assigned; the omission of specific duties does not preclude the assignment of duties logically related to this position.

**Core Competencies**

* Demonstrated commitment to centering racial equity and anti\-racist principles in organizational work.
* Excellent strategic judgment and political acumen.
* Ability to build meaningful relationships and collaborate effectively with staff, partners, and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.
* Ability to manage multiple communications initiatives while maintaining quality, meeting deadlines, and advancing organizational priorities.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to changing priorities, emerging opportunities, and rapid\-response needs.
* Proactive, creative, and solutions\-oriented approach to challenges.
* Exceptional project\- and time\-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and active\-listening skills.
* Consistent attention to detail and commitment to producing timely, high\-quality work.
* Ability to remain effective, organized, and composed in a small, fast\-paced organization with multiple competing priorities.

**Key Relationships**


This position will report to the Chief Development Officer as part of the Development and External Affairs function and supervise the Digital \& Content Communications Specialist. The Director will serve as the lead communications strategist for both We Build Progress and PCAF and work closely with organizational leadership, program and development staff, external partners, vendors, and consultants.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* At least eight years of progressively responsible communications experience, including significant experience leading an organization\-wide communications strategy, advising senior executives, managing staff and external partners, and overseeing multiple communications functions.
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing integrated communications strategies that advance organizational goals and strengthen brand visibility, positioning, and audience engagement.
* Experience serving as a senior communications adviser to executives or organizational leaders, including advising on sensitive issues, reputational risks, rapid\-response needs, and high\-profile opportunities.
* Excellent strategic judgment and political acumen, including the ability to identify communications opportunities, navigate complex or sensitive issues, and make sound decisions in a rapidly evolving environment.
* Strong understanding of policymaking and legislative processes and the ability to quickly synthesize complex policy issues and translate them into clear, compelling communications for varied audiences.
* Exceptional writing and editing skills, with experience producing high\-quality content across audiences, formats, and channels.
* Experience developing and executing media\-relations strategies, responding to press inquiries, pitching stories and organizational experts, and preparing leaders or subject\-matter experts for media opportunities.
* Experience overseeing digital communications strategies and channels, including email, websites, and social media.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, time\-sensitive communications initiatives involving multiple departments, external partners, competing priorities, and firm deadlines.
* At least two years of experience supervising staff and leading a communications function or team.
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills, including the ability to lead initiatives from concept through execution, manage multiple priorities, and maintain high standards of quality and accuracy.
* Ability to work occasional evenings and weekends in support of events, organizational priorities, and rapid\-response communications needs.

 **Preferred:**

* Established relationships with reporters, editors, producers, podcasters, content creators, and other media professionals covering Congress, public policy, progressive advocacy, or related issues.
* Experience partnering with fundraising or development teams on donor and funder communications, grassroots fundraising campaigns, sponsorship materials, and other development collateral.
* Experience leading communications for major conferences, convenings, campaigns, or public events.
* Experience developing and managing crisis or rapid\-response communications.
* Experience supporting communications across distinct 501(c)(3\) and 501(c)(4\) organizations and understanding the legal and strategic considerations applicable to each.

 **Salary and Benefits**


The salary range for this position is **$150,000–$160,000**. The final salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s relevant experience and qualifications and will be consistent with We Build Progress’s compensation framework and internal equity considerations.


We Build Progress offers excellent benefits, including 20 days of paid vacation annually, 10 paid sick days, one personal day per month, additional paid holiday leave between December 24 and January 1, a 5% employer match on 401(k) contributions, 100% employer\-paid health, dental, and vision insurance for employees, generous paid parental leave, and other benefits consistent with the Employee Handbook.

**FLSA Classification**


Exempt, full\-time.

 **Location**


This is a remote position based in the Washington, DC, metropolitan area, with regular in\-person responsibilities related to meetings, events, media opportunities, and other organizational activities. Candidates must currently live in or be willing to relocate to the Washington, DC, metropolitan area.

 **Commitment to Diversity**


We Build Progress is an equal opportunity and fair\-chance employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, family responsibilities, personal appearance, political affiliation, military or veteran status, caregiver status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

  

We strongly encourage applications from people of color, women, LGBTQ\+ people, people with disabilities, and people from other communities historically underrepresented in nonprofit, policy, and advocacy leadership.

 **About We Build Progress**


We Build Progress is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit that puts power in the hands of the people. We equip frontline communities with analysis and tools, amplify their voices, strengthen coalitions, demystify Congress, and advance policies that dismantle oppression and deliver real, lasting progress.  

  

This search is being lead by NRG Consulting Group. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis with a preferred deadline of 10/5/26\. Reach out to jobs@nrgconsultinggroup.org with any questions.

description:

-------------------------



As the SEO \& GEO Manager at N26, you will be responsible for driving organic user acquisition across all digital channels and emerging AI search engines (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini). You will blend technical SEO rigor, data analytics, high\-authority content strategy, and semantic optimization to ensure N26 remains the primary mobile banking recommendation across traditional search engines and AI discovery platforms.



You will sit at the intersection of Marketing, Data, Product, and Content, scaling our organic footprint across multiple European markets while building N26's pioneer strategy in AI search visibility.

  


**In this role, you will:**


**Traditional \& Technical SEO**


* Search Strategy: Define, execute, and scale the multi\-market organic search roadmap across key N26 operating markets (Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Austria, and pan\-Europe).
* Technical SEO Leadership: Partner with Product and Web Engineering teams to maintain flawless technical site health, addressing site speed, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, dynamic rendering, and international multi\-language architecture (hreflang).
* High\-Intent Content Strategy: Collaborate with the Product Marketing and Brand teams to build and optimize localized, compliant fintech content targeting high\-intent, converting keywords.


**Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) \& AI Visibility**


* AI Search Strategy: Develop N26's framework for GEO, optimizing web presence to maximize brand recommendation, inclusion, and positive sentiment in AI\-generated answers (e.g., ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
* Knowledge Graph \& Entity Management: Optimize structured data (Schema.org), digital entity relationships, and authoritative external references to establish N26 as the definitive financial authority for LLMs.
* Citation \& Share of Voice Monitoring: Establish benchmarks, tracking metrics, and custom tools to measure N26's share of AI voice (SoAIV) and recommendation rates against competitors in conversational search.


**Analytics, Testing \& Reporting**


* Performance Tracking: Deliver standard organic acquisition dashboards tracking organic traffic, sign\-ups, and keyword/entity rankings.
* Testing \& Experimentation: Run continuous A/B and multivariate tests on title tags, semantic markup, content structuring, and internal linking to drive conversion rate optimization (CRO) and crawl efficiency.
* Market Insights: Monitor algorithm updates, AI model updates, and regulatory shifts to proactively adapt our growth tactics.

**What you need to be successful:**
-----------------------------------


* Experience: 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in SEO within high\-growth tech companies, fintechs, or large\-scale consumer digital products across multi\-language markets.
* GEO \& AI Search Mastery: Proven understanding of how Large Language Models (LLMs) ingest, index, and cite web sources, alongside practical experience optimizing content for AI platforms.
* Technical Proficiency: Strong command of HTML/CSS, technical SEO auditing tools (Screaming Frog, Log analysis, etc.), dynamic rendering, and structured data implementation.
* Data Fluency: Advanced knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Ahrefs, Semrush, and SQL/Python/R (a plus for large dataset analysis and API integrations).
* Language: Fluent written and spoken English. Professional proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or Italian is a strong advantage.


**Nice\-to\-Haves**


* Experience working with programmatic SEO and automated content workflows.
* Familiarity with vector databases, semantic search embeddings, and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) concepts.
* Experience in App Store Optimization (ASO) for iOS and Android.

  


**What's in it for you:**
-------------------------


Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most talked about disruptors * .
* Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness \& wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
* As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
* Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
* A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies \- all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
* A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

**Who we are**
--------------



N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.



We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.



We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500\-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road\-legal VARG EX \& SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.

* A fast\-growing company with real momentum
* A creative, international team based in Barcelona

title: Strategy Manager
description:
**MGID** is a global advertising technology company and pioneer in native advertising, operating a programmatic platform that connects advertisers and publishers across 200\+ countries. The company runs a real\-time bidding (OpenRTB) business model with AI\-powered targeting and content recommendation widgets, serving hundreds of millions of users monthly.  

  

MGID is seeking a **Strategy Manager** to help define and execute the company’s multi\-year strategic direction, with a strong focus on shifting from a product\-led to a customer\-value\-led mindset, evaluating strategic product and investment opportunities, and cascading strategy into prioritized, cross\-functional initiatives.


This role sits within a fast\-moving, data\-driven ad\-tech environment and reports to the COO.

 **Role Purpose**


The Strategy Manager will act as a key strategic partner to the COO and leadership team, responsible for shaping MGID’s medium\- to long\-term strategy, evaluating strategic options for products and markets, and ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into concrete, prioritized projects with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

 **Who You Are:**

* 10\+ years of experience in strategy, corporate development, or related roles within international tech scale\-ups or high\-growth environments; ad\-tech or programmatic advertising experience is a strong plus.
* Proven track record in a top\-tier consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Big Four strategy practices) or equivalent strategic role in a tech company.
* Hands\-on experience preparing and presenting successful strategic cases with visible internal impact, such as new market entry, product portfolio optimization, or major investment decisions.
* Strong financial modeling skills, including practical experience with valuation methods such as DCF, NPV, and IRR, and the ability to build and maintain investment models in Excel.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with product, commercial, data/BI, and operations leaders in a fast\-paced, remote\-first environment.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills; able to influence senior audiences and drive alignment across geographies.
* Self\-starter mindset: ready to operate as an individual contributor who can both design strategy and execute hands\-on.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Corporate \& Product Strategy**

* Lead the identification and articulation of MGID’s overall strategy and strategic direction for the next 3–5 years, aligning with business focus and growth trajectory.
* Evaluate strategic perspectives for specific products and portfolios, assessing market exposure, competitive dynamics, and growth potential.
* Support the shift from a product\-led to a customer\-value\-led company by embedding customer\-centric frameworks into strategic planning, prioritization, and roadmap decisions.

**Investment \& Business Evaluation**

* Lead evaluations of stand\-alone investment opportunities, including new products, markets, partnerships, and M\&A, and prepare robust business cases with clear financial impact assessments.
* Own and evolve company evaluation models, including DCF, NPV, IRR, and scenario analysis, and ensure consistent application across strategic and investment decisions.
* Support participation in accelerators and corporate venture initiatives to identify and select startup investments that drive business growth and strategic synergy.

**Strategy Execution \& Prioritization**

* Cascade corporate strategy into granular projects and initiatives, working closely with the CPO, CRO, and BI Director on prioritization, resourcing, and sequencing.
* Define KPIs and performance frameworks to track strategy implementation and outcomes, and establish governance and reporting routines for strategic workstreams.
* Monitor progress, adapt plans in response to changing market conditions, and recommend corrective actions to keep strategic initiatives on track.

**Strategic Analysis \& Advisory**

* Conduct market, competitor, and customer analysis to inform strategic choices and identify opportunities and risks.
* Facilitate scenario planning and stress testing to assess strategic resilience under different market and regulatory conditions.
* Present strategic recommendations and status updates to senior leadership, influencing decision\-making with clear, evidence\-based insights.


At **MGID**, we thrive on innovation, collaboration, and a passion for AdTech. Our culture is built on openness, transparency, and a shared drive for excellence. We empower our teams to take bold steps, embrace challenges, and grow together in a dynamic, people\-first environment. Here, your ideas matter, your contributions are valued, and your potential has no limits. Join us and shape the future of digital advertising!

This position demands strong collaborative communication skills, including the ability to engage with and influence a diverse range of stakeholders both within and external to AstraZeneca. * Lead cross functional projects to ensure the successful passage of drugs through all phases of the drug development process, or contribute to one or more elements of such a project as a technical expert.
* Review and interpret medical data and clinical trial data and come up with conclusions with Medical Director
* You will support the development of clinical components of regulatory and EC/IRB submission documents for instances where marketing approval is warranted. Prepare and provide input to clinical study reports (CSRs) and clinical portions of Regulatory Documents (e.g., IB, DSUR, PSUR, regulatory responses)
* Participate or lead as needed the review and assessment of new opportunities and ESRs.
* Responsible for timely responses to investigational study sites for local ICF changes, protocol \& EC/IRB questions/requests.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**


* BS required, PhD in a scientific field, PharmD or MD is strongly preferred
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience
* Industry or Academic experience in drug development required with experience in malignant haematology clinical trials strongly preferred.
* Sufficient technical knowledge (haemato\-oncology background preferred) to be able to interact with confidence with internal and external partner
* Possesses sound foundational knowledge of FDA and other major country regulations and detailed knowledge of Good Clinical Practice other regulations governing clinical research.

title: Founding SDR (DACH market)
description:
#### **About The Role**


Vivid Money is redefining how modern businesses, growing SMEs, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From high\-yield Interest Accounts and multi\-currency infrastructure to treasury tools and team cards, we provide the modern financial platform that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.


We are expanding our business presence across Germany.


We aren’t looking for an SDR to just follow a pre\-written playbook; we are looking for our **Founding SDR** for the **DACH market.** Working directly alongside our Founding Account Executive, you will be employee number one on the SDR side, responsible for building the outbound engine from scratch. Your core focus will be opening doors with SMB decision\-makers (CEOs, CFOs, Finance Directors), while strategically mapping and testing outreach to adjacent personas like holding structures, PE/VC portfolio leads, and family offices.


If you want the autonomy of a founding team member, want to write the prospecting playbook, and want to establish the top\-of\-funnel blueprint for Vivid in Germany, this role is for you.

#### **Your Mission**

* **Build the Outbound Engine:** Architect, build, and test our cold outreach sequences across phone, email, and LinkedIn targeting SMB decision\-makers across Germany.
* **Map \& Test New Personas:** Experiment with outreach strategies for secondary personas, including holding companies, VC/PE portfolio managers, and corporate service providers, to help define our expanded ICP.
* **Generate High\-Volume Pipeline:** Own top\-of\-funnel growth by sourcing, qualifying, and booking high\-intent discovery meetings for the Founding Account Executive.
* **Design the Playbook:** Partner directly with Sales Leadership to document what works, establishing the framework, templates, and best practices for future SDR hires.
* **Leverage AI \& Sales Infrastructure:** Help select, implement, and optimize our AI\-native prospecting stack, utilizing AI tools to automate research, trigger tracking, and hyper\-personalized messaging.
* **Continuous Feedback Loop:** Gather market feedback from prospect interactions to help refine product positioning, objections handling, and GTM messaging.

#### **Your Profile**

* **1–3 years of outbound prospecting experience** (SDR/BDR) in B2B FinTech, SaaS, or financial services, preferably within the DACH market.
* **Founding/Builder mindset:** High agency, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating processes from scratch rather than just executing existing ones.
* **Persona curiosity:** Ability to speak the language of SMB founders and CFOs, with a strong interest in learning how different corporate entities and treasury setups operate.
* **Tech\-savvy \& AI\-native:** Active user of modern sales stacks and AI prospecting tools to maximize outreach efficiency.
* **Tenacious \& resilient:** Motivated by raw pipeline creation, testing new angles, and iterating quickly based on response data.
* **Languages:** Full professional fluency in German and English is required.

#### **Why Join Vivid?**

* Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Barcelona office or fully remote from other locations.
* Direct influence on go\-to\-market strategy and revenue growth.
* Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities.
* AI\-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
* Learning \& development budget to support your professional growth.
* Fully paid vacation and sick leave.
* Sports compensation.
* Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.

#### **Compensation range**


Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender\-neutral criteria.

#### **About Vivid**


At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi\-IBAN accounts, high\-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150\+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.  

  

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.  

  

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.  

  

We're building Vivid as an AI\-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day\-to\-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high\-impact decision\-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI\-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

title: Marketing Director
description:

Graitec is a global leader in Building Information Modeling (BIM) solutions, designing and developing software that helps architects, engineers, and manufacturers design smarter and better. With over 30 years of innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit, we’ve tripled our revenue in just five years.

  

Our North Star is clear — accelerate the digital transformation of the AECO industry and model the future. We achieve this by growing our recurring revenue through innovative software and services that drive adoption, integration, and lasting value for our customers.

  

Our 800 experts across 30\+ offices in 12 countries support more than 270,000 users worldwide. As a global Autodesk Platinum Partner, we combine world\-class partnerships with our own cutting\-edge software and services to drive performance and sustainability across the industry.

  

At Graitec, we move fast and think big. We collaborate across teams and borders, embrace diversity, and challenge ourselves to innovate every day. We believe in doing the right thing, breaking down silos, and making an impact together.

 **How we work:** Growth, Agility, Innovation, Responsibility  

**How we behave:** Ambition, Engagement, One Graitec, Positive Energy  

**Learn more about the Graitec Group:** graitec\-group.com/graitec\-a\-global\-player


About the Team Hiring:

The Campaign Execution team is the operational engine of Graitec's Growth Marketing function. We translate marketing strategy into always\-on, measurable programs that generate pipeline and drive revenue across 13 countries. The team spans marketing automation, content, email execution, program operations, and global campaign delivery.

  

Graitec is 40 years old and moving faster than ever. We are transitioning from a leading Autodesk reseller into a global IP software company — and marketing is central to that transformation. We have brand presence, a large customer base, and a growing product portfolio. What we need now is the execution infrastructure to convert that into predictable, scalable pipeline.

  

This role exists because we are ready to move beyond campaigns. We run programs — launches, events, seasonal pushes — and we run them well. But we have not yet built the always\-on growth engine that compounds over time: the lifecycle programs that never stop nurturing, the automation plays that respond to buyer signals in real time, and the performance loop that tells us what to scale and what to cut. That is what this Director helps build.


Overview:
* The Marketing Director (Global Campaign Execution) builds and leads the global marketing execution engine that converts audience engagement into qualified pipeline — evolving Graitec from discrete campaigns to always\-on, AI\-enabled growth programs that compound over time.
* Reporting to the VP, Global Growth Marketing, the Director leads a team of five and partners across Growth Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Solutions Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Revenue Operations. The VP sets strategy and organizational direction; this role owns the always\-on execution engine and is accountable for its pipeline contribution.

 **Always\-On Growth Engine:**

* In partnership with the VP, help drive the transition from building campaigns from scratch each quarter to running programs that are always on — spending team time improving what works rather than restarting from zero.
* Design and build full\-funnel lifecycle programs — acquisition, activation, expansion, retention — that run continuously and compound over time.
* Manage the operating model within the strategic direction set by the VP — campaign frameworks, channel mix execution, audience segmentation, and the feedback loops that drive optimization  

Use AI tools to accelerate personalization, content generation, campaign testing, and performance analysis at scale.

 **Campaign Orchestration \& Pipeline Acceleration:**

* Execute against campaign strategy set by the VP and Corporate and Solutions Marketing — translating strategy into activated, multi\-channel programs.
* Drive the campaign calendar, production timelines, and cross\-functional coordination across Growth Marketing, SDR, and Sales.
* Lead pipeline acceleration programs — ABM plays, nurture sequences, and SDR\-aligned follow\-up strategies — that move opportunities through the funnel.
* Identify the highest\-performing campaign motions, build the case to scale them, and present recommendations to the VP for approval.

 **Marketing Automation, Data \& Technology:**

* Own the global marketing automation platform as a revenue system — not a broadcast tool — ensuring it operates with precision, segmentation, and measurable impact.
* Drive lead scoring, routing logic, nurture architecture, and CRM data quality in close collaboration with Revenue Operations.
* Implement the first\-party data strategy set by the VP — enabling signal\-based, personalized marketing at scale.
* Evaluate and recommend AI\-powered marketing tools that improve targeting accuracy, content relevance, and campaign efficiency.

 **Performance Reporting \& Revenue Visibility:**

* Own marketing's performance narrative — pipeline attribution, campaign ROI, funnel conversion, and lifecycle metrics — reported to the VP and broader leadership on a regular cadence.
* Build the dashboards and data infrastructure that give leadership real\-time visibility into marketing's contribution to revenue.
* Drive a culture of measurement, rapid experimentation, and evidence\-based decision\-making across the team.

 **Partner \& Co\-Marketing Programs:**

* Lead Autodesk MDF/MDP co\-marketing strategy and execution — moving from compliance reporting to strategic pipeline generation.
* Develop co\-marketing campaigns that integrate with the broader campaign calendar and are measured against pipeline contribution.

 **Team Leadership \& Organizational Development:**

* Lead, develop, and elevate a team of five — setting high standards for execution quality, accountability, and strategic contribution.
* Build a team culture where feedback loops are fast, testing is the norm, and performance is visible and celebrated.
* Develop each team member's capability over time, moving the team from executors to strategic contributors.

 **The Team:**

  

You will lead five direct reports spanning automation, content, program operations, and campaign execution:

* **Campaign Marketing Manager** — Global campaign execution, Italian market, Autodesk MDF/MDP co\-marketing.
* **Marketing Automation Manager** — Global automation platform, nurture architecture, lead scoring and routing.
* **Content Specialist** — Blog publishing, web content, editorial calendar execution.
* **Marketing Programs Manager** — Campaign operations, project management, product line and regional activation.
* **Email Execution Specialist** — Campaign build and deployment, platform operations, list management.

  

This is an execution\-strong team with room to grow strategically. Your job is to raise the ceiling.

 **Key Partners:**

* **Corporate Marketing** — Campaign strategy, core content, brand direction
* **Solutions Marketing** — Product positioning, messaging, GTM strategy
* **Digital Marketing** — SEO/GEO, paid media, analytics, web performance
* **Events \& Community** — Regional events, community programs, field activation
* **SDR Practice** — Lead qualification, pipeline acceleration, outbound plays
* **Sales** — Pipeline alignment, deal acceleration, win/loss insight
* **Revenue Operations** — Attribution, data governance, pipeline definitions, reporting

 **Business Purpose \& Value Contribution:**

  

Graitec is at an inflection point. In the last four years we doubled in size. In the next few years, we intend to do it again — this time driven by our own software, not just the products we resell. This Director role sits at the center of that ambition: if marketing gets this right, pipeline becomes predictable, sales cycles shorten, and the brand shifts in the market.

  

The role converts marketing strategy into revenue outcomes. It is accountable for the infrastructure — programs, automation, data, and reporting — that makes marketing's contribution to pipeline visible, repeatable, and scalable across all 13 countries.

  

You will work in a flat, entrepreneurial environment where leaders have real ownership — not a committee for every decision. You will have access to a team ready to grow, a VP who thinks strategically and removes obstacles, and a transformation story that is genuinely compelling in the market.

 **Key Outcomes Expected:**

  

Performance is reviewed quarterly against pipeline and revenue contribution, campaign effectiveness, and the team's progression toward an always\-on operating model. Annual targets are set in partnership with the VP, Global Growth Marketing and Revenue Operations.

 **Pipeline \& Revenue:**

* Marketing\-sourced pipeline ($ and %)
* Marketing\-influenced pipeline
* MQL to SQL to Opportunity conversion rates
* Pipeline velocity

 **Campaign Performance:**

* Pipeline generated per campaign
* Campaign ROI and cost per opportunity
* Engagement rates by channel
* Channel efficiency benchmarks

 **Lifecycle \& Retention:**

* Nurture\-to\-opportunity rate
* Time\-to\-conversion by stage
* Lead recycling effectiveness
* Churn influence via retention plays

 **Operational Excellence:**

* Campaign launch consistency
* Attribution model accuracy
* Automation platform adoption
* Data quality and database health

 **What Success looks like at 12 Months:**

* The team is running always\-on programs — key lifecycle and demand programs are live, being optimized continuously, and not rebuilt from scratch each quarter.
* Marketing has a clear, trusted pipeline attribution model — leadership and Sales agree on the numbers, and they are reported in real time.
* The Campaign Execution team is viewed as a strategic pipeline partner by Sales and SDR — not a service function that produces assets.
* AI tools are embedded in how the team works — accelerating personalization, content, testing, and reporting.
* Each team member has a clear development path and is operating at or above the expectations set for their role.
* Autodesk co\-marketing is generating measurable pipeline contribution, not just MDF compliance.


Responsibilities:
* 8–12 years in B2B marketing, with a majority of that time in demand generation, growth marketing, or campaign execution leadership.
* Demonstrated experience building always\-on marketing programs — lifecycle nurture, ABM, automated demand gen — that were measured against pipeline, not activity.
* Hands\-on proficiency with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot strongly preferred) and CRM systems (Salesforce).
* Proven change management experience — you have led a team or function through a meaningful operational transformation, not just inherited a working model.
* Experience working in B2B SaaS or subscription software — you understand recurring revenue, expansion motion, and the full customer lifecycle.
* AI fluency — you use AI tools actively in your marketing practice and have a point of view on how they change what's possible for a team like this.
* Strong data and analytics capability — you can build attribution models, interpret funnel data, and communicate revenue impact to senior stakeholders.
* Track record of global or multi\-region marketing leadership.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

 **Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in AEC, construction tech, engineering software, or a technical B2B vertical with long sales cycles.
* Familiarity with Autodesk partner co\-marketing programs (MDF/MDP).
* Revenue Operations alignment experience — working alongside RevOps on shared pipeline definitions, data governance, and reporting.
* Experience with intent data platforms, CDPs, or signal\-based marketing orchestration.

 **How You Lead:**

* You are a builder, not a maintainer — you see the gap between where things are and where they should be, and you close it.
* You lead with data and communicate with executive clarity — metrics tell you what to do, but you decide how to frame it for the room.
* You raise the floor on execution quality while raising the ceiling on strategic ambition.
* You operate at the intersection of strategy and operations without losing altitude on either end.
* You build trust quickly with peers in Sales, SDR, Solutions Marketing, and Corporate Marketing — you influence without authority as often as you direct.

title: Game Producer (Hybrid Casual)
description:
**Who are we?**
---------------


**Tripledot** **Studios** is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.


We are a multi\-award\-winning organisation, with a global 2,500\+ strong team across 12 studios.


Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.


Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.


We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail\-orientated people, who **LOVE** making games.


Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.


**The role is working within our studio: Belka Games**
------------------------------------------------------


Belka Games is a game development company. According to Sensor Tower, the company is among the top 30 highest\-grossing game developers in Europe, and its audience has recently surpassed 110 million players.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


We’re looking for an experienced **Game Producer to build new Hybrid Casual games from scratch**.


You’ll identify product opportunities, test game hypotheses, and guide projects from concept and prototype through marketability, launch, retention validation, and D7/D30 performance evaluation.


This role is ideal for someone with hands\-on Hybrid Casual experience who can move quickly in a high\-uncertainty environment, make data\-driven decisions, and confidently decide when to iterate – and when to stop.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* **Creating new games from scratch.** Identify promising product opportunities and turn them into testable game concepts and prototypes
* **Researching the market.** Monitor Hybrid Casual trends, emerging mechanics, successful products, competitors, player behavior, and new market opportunities
* **Leading projects through early\-stage validation.** Take games from concept and prototype through marketability testing, technical launch, retention testing, and D7/D30 validation
* **Defining product hypotheses and validation criteria.** Determine what needs to be tested at each stage and what minimum product scope is required to get a reliable answer
* **Making go / iterate / kill decisions.** Analyze test results and decide whether to continue development, change direction, or stop a project
* **Owning early\-stage product metrics.** Analyze CPI, CTR, retention, engagement, playtime, monetization, ARPU/ARPDAU, ROAS, and other key indicators of product potential
* **Developing the core product.** Work closely with Game Design on core gameplay, progression, difficulty, economy, meta systems, and monetization required for successful validation
* **Working closely with UA and Creative teams.** Evaluate marketability and creative potential together with product metrics and identify opportunities for further testing
* **Running multiple product hypotheses.** Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of concepts and experiments rather than focusing exclusively on the long\-term development of one mature product
* **Leading a cross\-functional R\&D team.** Coordinate Game Design, Development, Art, Analytics, UA, and Creative teams to move from hypothesis to validated product as efficiently as possible

**Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
--------------------------------------------


* 3\+ years of experience as a **Game Producer, Product Manager, Product Owner, or Lead Game Designer** in mobile games
* Proven experience taking **multiple game concepts from idea or prototype to market validation**, including projects that reached retention and D7/D30 testing stages.
* **A portfolio of Hybrid Casual projects** where you can clearly explain:
* + the original product hypothesis
	+ how the concept was validated
	+ which metrics were used
	+ what results were achieved
	+ what decisions were made based on those results
* Strong understanding of the **Hybrid Casual mobile games market**, including current genres, mechanics, monetization models, and product trends
* Strong understanding of early\-stage product and UA metrics, including **CPI, CTR, retention, engagement, playtime, ARPU/ARPDAU, and ROAS**
* Ability to identify whether a project's main issue lies in **core gameplay, product depth, monetization, creatives, or user acquisition**, and define the next experiment accordingly
* Strong analytical and product thinking with the ability to make decisions based on incomplete data
* Experience managing and coordinating cross\-functional development teams
* Strong communication, leadership, and prioritization skills

**Working at Tripledot**
------------------------


* **Hybrid Working**
* **25 days paid holiday** in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year
* **20 days remote working:** Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year
* **Regular company events and rewards:** Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements and our team spirit
* **Private Medical Cover:** Have peace of mind with private medical cover, ensuring your health is in good hands
* **Life \& Critical Illness Cover:** Protect your future with our life and critical illness cover.
* **Family Forming Support:** Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program \[subject to policy]
* **Employee Assistance Program:** Access confidential support anytime through our Employee Assistance Program
* **Sport Compensation:** Stay fit and active with our sport compensation benefit
* **Meal and Transport Vouchers:** Save on meals and transport with our convenient vouchers
* **English \& Spanish Classes:** Enhance your English and Spanish skills with our provided language classes
* **Continuous Professional Development:** Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development

title: Lead Product Manager - Travel Tech
description:
**About BizAway**

  

Here at BizAway, we Deliver the Future of Travel. 😎  

  

We are a solid international company with strong ambitions and great expertise. With a focus on sustainability 🌱, we support companies on a daily basis, enabling them to improve their travel management through our constantly evolving services and solutions, always characterized by our tech attitude and smart and innovative processes. 🚀  

  

We know that success comes from People and deserves to be recognized.👫Proactivity and reliability, collaboration and communication are the core values of our culture.  

  

If you like challenges and would love to be part of one of the fastest growing B2B scale\-ups, then BizAway is the company you have been looking for. 🤩  

  

**We are looking for**  

  

We’re looking for a **Lead Product Manager** \- **t****ravel.tech (APIs, MCP \& Provider Integrations)** to guide the core platform: the REST API, the MCP server, the developer experience, and the provider integrations that power everything underneath.  

  

**Your role in BizAway**

* Guide the agentic AI strategy — define how BizAway's platform surfaces as a first\-class citizen in the agentic internet. Drive the MCP roadmap and tool surface (search, hold, book, modify, cancel, disruption recovery), define the auth model (OAuth 2\.1, per\-agent scopes, spend caps) that makes it enterprise\-safe, and own distribution across the MCP Registry, Claude Plugin Marketplace, and Zapier.
* Own the API product — define and evolve the roadmap for travel.tech's REST API. Own the full developer lifecycle: endpoint design, versioning strategy, webhook architecture, and sandbox environment.
* Own the provider integration layer — work closely with engineering to ensure content quality, latency, and feature parity across all providers: Amadeus, TravelFusion, Trainline, and others.
* Shape the developer experience — make travel.tech the easiest travel API to integrate. Support docs, sandbox, SDK quality, and onboarding flows for the target developer personas.
* Measure what matters — define and track the metrics that prove platform health: API latency, MCP tool invocation volume, sandbox\-to\-production conversion rate, and more.
* Drive adoption and monetization — own the pricing model, API tier design, usage analytics, and conversion from free tier to Growth and Enterprise.

### **What we're looking for**

* Systems thinker first — you naturally model problems as systems, map dependencies before drawing solutions, and instinctively ask what breaks at 10x scale. You think in interfaces, contracts, and failure modes before you think in features.
* 5 – 8 years as a Product Manager, with at least 2–3 years leading a developer platform, integration\-heavy B2B SaaS domain, or consumer\-grade API product.
* Data\-driven — you define metrics before you build, instrument the platform properly, and know the difference between a latency regression and a content gap.
* Strong technical foundation — you can read API specs, have strong opinions on REST design and webhook reliability, and can have a real conversation with a backend and platform team. You are opinionated about API and data model style — you know what a clean, consumer\-grade API feels like and you won't ship one that doesn't meet that bar.
* Working knowledge of API authentication systems — including HMAC and OAuth, with a clear understanding of the tradeoffs between auth approaches in multi\-tenant, agentic contexts.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/LLM integrations — you understand Model Context Protocol deeply: how MCP tool schemas are designed, what makes an MCP server first\-class in Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, and others. Prior experience shipping or maintaining an MCP server is a strong differentiator.
* Data\-driven — you define metrics before you build, instrument the platform properly, and know the difference between a latency regression and a content gap.
* Travel tech fluency (nice to have) — familiarity with the supplier stack: airlines via GDS (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport) and NDC, hotel aggregators (Expedia Partner Solutions, Booking.com for Business, Hotelbeds), EU/UK rail, and car rental aggregators.
* Fluent in English (Spanish or Italian a plus).

**Why join us**

location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, CT, ES
description:
**Product Owner**
=================


Own the product, not the ticket queue — the business relationship, the backlog, acceptance, and whether the thing actually gets used.


Mainloop is a **new engineering team inside an established international group**. We are in Barcelona, we are being built from scratch this year, and we have the backing, the customers and the product portfolio of a company that has been around for decades. You get the interesting part of a new team without the part where you check whether payroll clears.


Two more things about where this comes from and where it goes. **The group has been running a techlab in Casablanca for more than eight years** — Barcelona is its second, built to sit closer to the teams we build for, and AI\-native from the first commit, because it starts from a blank page. And the plan does not stop at internal work: **within about a year and a half we intend to externalise** — external clients, our products sold on the market, products developed for it. The first eighteen months are deliberately spent building as much as possible for the group while the machine gets set up. You would arrive at the start of that curve, not after it.


What we build is the software that automates professional\-services work — across roughly fifteen countries, for businesses drowning in administration: the forms, the approvals, the reconciliations, the spreadsheet somebody rebuilds every month. We work in two halves. One half goes into a business, finds out what really happens there, and proves fast whether an idea is worth having. **The other half — your half — takes what is proven and owns it for years: gathers the needs, keeps building, gets it adopted, and makes sure it stays worth having.** Most automation teams stop at the demo. The entire point of ours is that we do not.

**We are not looking for a backlog administrator.** If your last role was turning other people's decisions into tickets and running the ceremonies around them, this is a different job. Here you are the product manager *and* the product owner: there is no one above you writing the strategy for your products, and no one below you writing the stories. What should exist, in what order, and whether what shipped is right — that is yours.

##### **What the job actually is**


A product arrives with a handover pack — already proven with its stakeholders by the first half of the team, already hardened for production. From day one it belongs to you and one developer, as a pair, for its life.

* **You own the relationship with the business.** Real people, in real offices, whose working day your product either improves or does not. You go and sit with them. Not a ticket queue — trust, built in person, held over years.
* **You gather the needs and you decide.** Your users cannot churn — they are in the building, and they will bring you more requests than any team could build. Most of this job is choosing: what moves the outcome, what waits, and what you decline with a reason the person asking can respect. **Saying no well is the defining skill here**, and you will have a product vision to say it from.
* **You write what should exist, precisely.** In our team, coding agents build most of what ships, steered by your developer. Agents amplify whatever they are given: a sharp specification becomes working software astonishingly fast, and a vague one becomes a thousand lines of confidently wrong code. Your needs, rules, edge cases and acceptance criteria are the most load\-bearing documents in the company. Writing them precisely is the highest\-leverage hour of your week.
* **You accept, or you don't.** When something ships, you are the person who checks the behaviour against what you wrote — with your own hands, in the product, against the criteria you set before the build. "The demo looked right" is not acceptance. You will get seriously good at defining what "done right" means in a way that can actually be checked.
* **You get it adopted, and you measure.** Our products do not have revenue to hide behind. A product that ships and is not used is a failure with good release notes. You own the follow\-up, the onboarding of new users with the business, and the number that says whether the thing is working — time saved, error rate, uptake — and you report that number whether it flatters us or not.
* **You carry a portfolio, not a product.** Every product we own is built on the same scaffold and arrives the same shape, which is what makes it possible for one PO to run several — each with its own developer, each with its own business. Variety is structural here: new products keep arriving from the other half of the team.
* **Your first product is real.** A live platform that a business runs on every day — real users, real history, real stakes. You inherit it from the person who has been carrying it, and part of your first months is taken up with the most useful thing a new PO can do: learning it properly before changing it.

##### **Why this job exists — the honest version**


Here is the thing our industry has just learned, and it is the reason we are hiring you: **AI made building fast, and it did not make building the right thing any more likely.** Surveys now find most companies shipping faster with AI while almost none can point to the return. It has never been easier to run, at speed, in the wrong direction.


In a team like ours the engineers steer agents, and implementation is rarely the bottleneck. **The bottleneck is deciding** — what to build, for whom, in what order, and whether what shipped actually did what the business needed. That is not a job the agents do. It is not really a job most engineers want. It is *this* job, and in an AI\-native team it is a more senior, more consequential job than the same title has ever been — because every decision you write down gets built, quickly, exactly as you wrote it.

**What stays yours, permanently:**

* **Deciding what not to build.** The agents will cheerfully build anything. Somebody has to be the person for whom "no" is a complete sentence with a number attached.
* **The relationship.** Being trusted by a business, reading what they need underneath what they ask for, and telling them a favourite idea is not worth it — there is no model for that.
* **Precision about what should exist.** Turning a messy, human, political need into a specification with exactly one correct interpretation is the hardest writing there is, and it is now the closest thing this industry has to source code.
* **Judgement about what came back.** Acceptance, in a world where software appears fast, is the quality bar. You are it.
* **The outcome.** Whether the business is actually better off. Somebody has to own that number rather than the ship date, and it is you.

##### **You will define how the PO role works here**


You are the first. That is not a gap in the org chart — it is the offer.


How product ownership works in an AI\-native team is a genuinely open question in our industry right now, and the honest answer is that nobody's playbook fits yet. Ours will be written here, over your first year, by you and Edouard together: how needs become specs, how acceptance works when agents build, how adoption gets measured, how many products one pair can carry. The POs we hire after you will be onboarded onto the way you built.


If you have ever read a process document and thought *I could have written this better* — this is the job where you get to.

##### **You will get seriously good at building with AI**


We are an AI\-native team, genuinely — not a team that added a Copilot licence. Everyone gets their own Claude Max subscription and the tooling to use it properly, and that includes you. The product people we admire in this market prototype with AI before they ask anyone to build: a rough working version of an idea, made in an afternoon, shown to a stakeholder — because a prototype communicates intent better than any document, and because it kills bad ideas cheaply. You will learn to do that here if you cannot already, and you will learn what makes a specification one an agent builds correctly the first time. That skill is being repriced upward across our entire industry, and this is one of very few jobs where you would practise it daily on products people depend on.

##### **The Mainloop Barcelona certificate**


Something we are building alongside the team, and we think it is genuinely unusual.


Over your first two to three years here you work through a defined body of knowledge — how we build, how we run products, how a need becomes a spec becomes working, adopted software — and when you can demonstrably run a product our way, you are awarded the **Mainloop Barcelona certificate**. It is yours: it goes on your CV, and we intend to make it mean something in this market. For a product person specifically, it certifies the thing the market is newly desperate for — that you can own products in an AI\-native team, end to end, with proof.

##### **How we build**

**Every product starts from the same scaffold, and it is the same in most of our repos — deliberately.** For you that is the whole point: every product in your portfolio has the same shape, so carrying several does not mean holding several different worlds in your head. It also means the handover pack you inherit from the first half of the team actually tells you how the thing works — because it is built the way everything else is built.


You do not need to arrive knowing our tooling, and this ad deliberately lists no technologies. You need to be technical enough to hold your own in an engineering discussion, and to read what an agent produced closely enough to judge it. The rest — our architecture, our patterns, our method — is what we train you on.

##### **Things worth knowing up front**

* **Barcelona is your base, and you will spend real time with the businesses.** The products serve people across roughly fifteen countries, and the relationship is the job — expect regular travel to sit with your users, on us. It is a fraction of what our deployed engineers do, but it is not zero, and the POs who never leave the office are the ones whose products stop being used.
* **Nobody is on call. Ever.** No rota, no pager. Alerts post to a channel and wait for morning. We protect evenings with engineering, not with people.
* **Nobody counts your hours or your tickets.** What gets looked at is whether your products are used, whether the business is better off, and whether your specs held up. Outcomes, not throughput.
* **We are building the team this year, and you will shape how it works.** That is truest of all for this seat — see above.

##### **If you would be moving to Barcelona for this**

**We do not expect you to absorb the cost of relocating, and we would rather say what we cover than leave you to ask.**

* **We pay to get you here.** Flights, your first month's accommodation while you find somewhere of your own, the visa and paperwork costs, and **an agent to handle the bureaucracy** — the NIE, the TIE appointment, the apostilles — instead of leaving you to meet the Spanish administrative system alone. Spanish lessons if you want them — and in this seat they will pay for themselves.
* **A relocation bonus, paid on arrival rather than dripped out.** It is repayable only if you leave within the first eighteen months, and that condition is the reason we can pay it up front — moving countries costs money at the start, not in year two.

**Three things here are worth more than they look on an offer comparison, particularly against a US one:**

* **Healthcare with no premium, no deductible and no network** — from day one, and not tied to staying in this job.
* **Thirty calendar days of holiday — that is 22 working days — plus fourteen public holidays**, roughly seven weeks in total. That is the statutory floor in Spain, not a benefit we are being generous with.
* **Nobody is on call. Ever.** It has its own line above and we mean it literally.

**If you are coming from the United States**, two things are usually worth more than the headline salary gap and almost nobody has done the arithmetic: **a salary here can sit below the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion**, and **federal student loans on an income\-driven plan are assessed on the income that exclusion has already removed.** We are not your tax advisor and you should get one — but ask in the first conversation and we will walk you through the comparison we ran, including the parts where the number comes out smaller.

##### **What we are looking for**

**One bar sits above everything else, so here it is plainly.** You can own a product end to end — the need, the decision, the specification, the acceptance, the outcome — and you are **technical enough to contribute to an engineering discussion and to judge what an AI agent built.** You do not need to code for a living. You do need to have no fear of the inside of the machine. If you read that and thought *that is the job I want*, keep reading.

**Read the rest as a description of the person you will be here, not a checklist you have to arrive with.** Almost nobody ticks all of it on day one, and we would rather hire the judgement and train the rest.

* **You have owned something real.** A product, a platform, a module — something in production, with users, where the backlog, the priorities and the outcome were genuinely yours. We will ask you to walk us through it, and to justify specific decisions inside it.
* **You are interested in how businesses actually work.** Processes, the mess in them, and why people do the odd things they do. Our products automate administrative work, and the PO who finds that boring will be bored.
* **You write with precision, and you like it.** The spec, the acceptance criteria and the "no, because…" are all documents, all read by people (and agents) who were not in the room. If your writing is where your thinking happens, you will be at home.
* **You can say no to someone senior, with a number.** And keep the relationship.
* **You use AI seriously** — for prototyping, for analysis, for your own writing — and you read what it produces the way you would read a colleague's work: with respect and suspicion.
* **You are comfortable with engineers**, and they with you. Our model is one PO and one developer owning each product together. That pair only works if you feed each other context instead of passing tickets over a wall.
* **English, fluently.** It is our working language — we work across roughly fifteen countries. Spanish is a genuine advantage day to day, and for your first product especially. Catalan is not required.
* **Barcelona**, with travel to your businesses.

**We do not care what you studied, and a Scrum certification is neither required nor an advantage.** We care what you have owned, what happened to it, and whether you can talk us through the decisions in it.

##### **How we hire**


Our process is unusual, so here it is up front. Four rounds, and none of them is a puzzle.

* **Fifteen minutes with Edouard.** A short first conversation — who you are, what you are after, and what this actually is. Enough for both of us to work out whether the next one is worth an hour.
* **A thirty\-minute conversation.** What you have owned, how you work, and how you think about it. We will ask you to walk us through a product you owned, and then to justify one specific prioritisation decision inside it: why that, why then, what you declined to do instead. There is no way to prepare for that and it is not meant to catch you out; it is how we tell ownership from proximity.
* **A conversation with our Casablanca team.** The group has run a tech lab there for more than eight years. You get people who have run production at real scale asking their own questions — and you get to ask them yours, including the ones you would rather not ask the person hiring you.
* **A working session built around a real product.** You read a real handover pack, sit with a real stakeholder, decide what matters, write the specification and the acceptance criteria — and then watch what our agents and your developer counterpart build from it, and tell us whether you would accept it, and what it would be worth. It is the closest thing to the real job we could design, and it works both ways: you will know a great deal about whether you want to work here by the end of it.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting\-edge technology. ### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-259586 **Date posted** 09/07/2026
“It is critical that we build and maintain our rich tradition of clinical expertise in support of developing life\-changing medicines for patients.” –Jose Baselga


The Baselga Cancer Research Scholars Program, initiated in 2020, is a 2\-year immersive education and research program for early\-career Oncologists who are inspired by science and by how clinical development has the potential to transform patient care. As part of a competitively selected cohort of Scholars, you will join an accelerated development track within Oncology R\&D. With individualized mentorship, there is opportunity to learn from a diverse group of experts across the drug development continuum, playing a pivotal role in channelling our scientific capabilities to make a positive impact on changing patients’ lives. Selected Scholars will join the current cohort of Baselga Cancer Research Scholars, building a vibrant community of drug developers. We are currently recruiting for the 2027 class with an aim to start the position in summer\-autumn 2027\.


**About AstraZeneca Oncology Research \& Development**


Our Oncology strategy is built with one goal in mind – pushing the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. We have a passion for discovery and a broad pipeline of next\-generation medicines, and together with a focus on execution excellence, we aim to expand treatment options and improve outcomes for patients with solid and haematological cancers. We’re pioneering innovative research across six scientific platforms: Tumor drivers and resistance; Immuno\-oncology, DNA damage response, Antibody drug conjugates, Epigenetics and Cell therapies.


Our ambition is to eliminate cancer as a cause of death. It’s our big vision that unites and inspires us. With multiple indications and high\-quality molecules at all stages of our innovative pipeline, we keep pushing forward. Focusing on cutting\-edge science with the latest technology to achieve breakthroughs.
