WHO WE ARE
  
  

**At Avolta (SIX:** AVOL), our people are at the driving force behind our success. With a team of over 76,000 individuals representing more than 150 nationalities, we are a truly global company driven by passion, innovation, and excellence.
  
  

Avolta is the leading global travel retail and food \& beverage player, placing the traveler at the heart of everything we do. By combining travel retail, convenience and F\&B, we create integrated and innovative experiences across the traveler’s journey.
  
  

Our 77,000 team members deliver these experiences every day across more than 5,100 outlets in around 1,000 locations, including airports, motorways and other travel destinations, in over 70 countries.
  
  

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
  
  

The Global Category Management Demand Planning Specialist supports the Produce category at a global level, driving accurate demand forecasting, sales and stock performance analysis, and effective inventory management across a luxury brands and stores. The role partners closely with Buying, Local Operations, and Finance to support seasonal Open‑to‑Buy (OTB) planning, optimize financial performance, manage stock risks, and improve forecasting accuracy through data‑driven insights and statistical modeling.
  
  

The role reports to the Global Category Management Planning \& Pricing Head and is based in Madrid, Spain.
  
  

RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

Build and maintain sales and demand forecasts by brand, category, and store across short\-, mid\-, and long\-term planning horizons
  
Translate sales forecasts into seasonal Open\-to\-Buy (OTB), stock targets, and replenishment plans
  
Produce and analyze financial KPI reports covering sales, margin, stock positions, weeks of supply (WOS), service levels, ageing stock, and forecast accuracy
  
Generate dashboards and management reports to support weekly trade meetings, monthly reviews, and effective decision\-making
  
Partner with Buyers, Retail teams, Local Operations, and Finance to plan new launches, special projects, seasonal demand, and store openings
  
Monitor terminal, slow\-moving, ageing, and obsolete stock positions, proactively highlighting risks and opportunities
  
Recommend and support proactive stock actions, including replenishments, transfers, returns to vendor (RTVs), markdown proposals, liquidation programs, and outlet clearance plans
  
Propose cost initiatives and support provision accruals related to stock obsolescence, ensuring clearance targets are aligned with financial expectations
  
Manage Never\-Out\-of\-Stock (NOS) replenishment and support day\-to\-day demand control using statistical forecast models
  
Continuously improve demand planning models, dashboards, and stock management processes by leveraging historical trends, seasonality, and client behavior
  
  

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  

1\-2 years of experience in demand planning, merchandising planning, inventory planning, supply chain planning, or a similar analytical role
  
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support business decision\-making
  
Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI or other reporting tools is considered an advantage
  
Exposure to forecasting, inventory management, replenishment, or retail planning processes is desirable
  
Experience with planning systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, or similar tools) is a plus
  
Detail\-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable working with large datasets
  
Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly to different stakeholders
  
Collaborative, proactive, and eager to learn and develop within a fast\-paced retail environment
  
Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset

We look forward to connecting with you soon!

title: People Operations Shared Service Specialist
description:
**Company Description**  

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95\+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos. People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

 **Job Description**  

We are currently seeking a People Operations Shared Service Specialist to join our dynamic team in Madrid, supporting our People Operations activities across France.


We are looking for someone with the right mindset above all, someone who is service\-oriented, solutions\-focused and proactive, with a genuine desire to anticipate the needs of People Managers and deliver a positive experience throughout the employee lifecycle.


In this role, you will provide first\-level People Operations support and guidance to Department Heads, responding to queries relating to HR and payroll policies, procedures and programmes. Queries will be managed through a ticketing system according to priority, with complex or sensitive matters escalated to the People Operations Business Partner for France, where appropriate.


You will provide comprehensive administrative support across the employee lifecycle, from recruitment and pre\-employment through to onboarding, employee changes and post\-hire administration. This will include, but is not limited to:

* Posting and closing vacancies through SmartRecruiters and Workday.
* Initiating and validating position and employee changes in Workday.
* Supporting the recruitment process and gathering feedback to help continuously improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.
* Managing a range of HR administration through Workday, the ATS and other People \& Culture systems and tools.
* Providing general HR and payroll administration support.

**Onboarding \& Employee Experience**


You will work closely with Department Heads to ensure a smooth, engaging and positive onboarding experience for new colleagues.


This will include:

* Preparing and sending onboarding documentation.
* Reviewing and validating required forms to ensure compliance and appropriate benefits setup.
* Configuring onboarding workflows and ensuring relevant information and access are in place within Workday.
* Supporting new hire communications and announcements.
* Gathering feedback and identifying opportunities to continuously improve the onboarding experience.

**Performance Management**


Support the administration and coordination of the performance management process, working closely with the People Operations Business Partner for France and the HRIS team.

**HR Administration \& Compliance**


Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records and HR documentation, ensuring compliance with legal requirements, RHG standards, processes and appropriate authorisation protocols.


Provide additional support across benefits administration, leave management and other People Operations activities as required.

**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**


Work closely with the People Operations Business Partner and the wider People Operations Shared Services team to deliver an efficient, consistent and high\-quality service.


You will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve the employee and manager experience and enhance the way People Operations services are delivered.

 **Qualifications**  

* Previous experience in Human Resources, People Operations, personnel administration, training and development, or a similar role.
* Experience within the hospitality or wider service industry is highly desirable.
* Good understanding of HR and payroll processes, policies and best practices.
* Experience using Workday, SmartRecruiters or similar HRIS/ATS platforms would be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong communication and customer service skills, with a proactive and solutions\-focused approach.
* Excellent attention to detail, organisation and confidentiality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work to deadlines and adapt to a fast\-paced and changing environment without compromising quality.
* A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the confidence to know when an issue requires escalation.

  

**Additional Information**  

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?  

  

Live the Magic of Hospitality \- Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.  

  

Build a Great Career \- No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development, helping you reach your full potential.  

  

Experience the Team Spirit \- Join a workplace that’s inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.  

  

Lead with Your Ambition \- Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference—in hospitality, your community and beyond.  

  

Enjoy Global \& Local Perks \- No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits \- like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!  

  

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you’re ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we’d love to hear from you.  

  

Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.  

  

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

title: Service Instructor - Sommelier
description:
**Service Instructor \- Sommelier**

**Permanent contract** / Marbella, Spain


Les Roches Global Hospitality Education, in the top 3 for Hospitality \& Leisure Management by the QS World University Ranking, is a brand of the Sommet Education Group. Founded in 1954, Les Roches is a private institution based on the Swiss model of experiential learning, offering undergraduate and graduate degrees in the fields of hospitality, tourism and event management. Les Roches prepares entrepreneurial and innovative graduates across a global network of campuses in Crans\-Montana (Switzerland), Marbella (Spain) and Abu Dhabi (UAE).


You share our values: Development, Distinctiveness, Joint commitment, Openness and Sense of service.

**Your profile:**

* Certification as a sommelier or a degree in hospitality is beneficial.
* Food handling certificate.
* High level of English essential, Spanish a plus.
* Minimum of 2\-3 previous experience as a sommelier, wine steward, or in a hospitality role.
* Extensive knowledge on wines and regions of the different types.
* Knowledge of local vineyards and wineries.
* Computer skills an advantage.
* Working in a team.
* Efficient communication skills.
* Strong oenology skills.
* Large volume service and time management.
* Previous experience as a sommelier, wine steward, or in a hospitality role.
* 2\-3 years minimum sommelier.

**Main tasks and responsibilities:**

* This is a position for an energetic individual, who will be able to integrate and assume responsibilities in any outlets and strive to achieve excellence every day.
* To actively educate and train students in different areas through practical classes together with fellow instructors, transmitting them knowledge, values, aptitudes, and the best abilities to attend to their needs and for their professional future.
* To actively contribute to driving sales, recommending wine varieties to our guests, supervising wine serving and collaborating with winemakers to renew our selections and achieve better prices.
* Prepare/setup operations according to criteria.
* To follow ordering protocol.
* Control and preservation of stock.
* Implement HACCP and product control in the various sections.
* Flexible working schedules, days, hours to comply with the job.
* Assist in teaching, according to the syllabus for each group.
* To be innovative and consistent in quality control.
* Effective communication/work with the students and Instructors.
* To implement the procedures of behavior and absences as per requirements.
* Provide feedback and support to the instructors concerning student evolvement.
* Creating and updating wine lists with the head sommelier and manager.
* Making recommendations on food and wine pairings.
* Ensuring that the wine cellar is fully stocked.
* Informing guests on the variety of wines available.
* Organizing wine tasting events.

description:
**Marketing Operations Manager / Lead Journey – Demand Generation CoE**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------


### **Role Summary**


The Marketing Operations Manager / Lead Journey sits within the **Demand Generation Center of Excellence (CoE) reporting to the Director of Customer Engagement, and owns the design, execution, and optimization of end\-to\-end lead journeys from anonymous engagement through MQL** across multiple global brands and regions.


This role owns the lead journey **from anonymous engagement through MQL handoff to Sales**, ensuring prospects are captured, identified, nurtured, scored, and qualified consistently. The Marketing Operations Manager / Lead Journey balances global standardization with regional flexibility to deliver frictionless, scalable lead journeys.


Lead flow is treated as a product: intentionally designed, governed, measured, and continuously improved.

  

### **What You’ll Be Responsible For**


* Own and optimize lead journeys from anonymous engagement through MQL across global brands
* Design and govern dark\-funnel capture, identification, nurturing, scoring, and qualification flows
* Own routing logic and lifecycle governance up to MQL handoff
* Align lead capture and engagement across web forms, chat, messaging, call\-back, and other interaction channels
* Partner with regional teams to adapt journeys to local market needs while maintaining global standards
* Monitor funnel performance through MQL; diagnose bottlenecks, leakage, and growth opportunities
* Govern lead data hygiene, taxonomy, and cross\-platform consistency
* Collaborate with analytics to improve attribution, scoring accuracy, and funnel reporting through MQL

**Who Should Apply / Desired Profile**
--------------------------------------


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys owning the **front half of the funnel** and making complexity invisible to customers and teams.


You may be a strong fit if you:


* Love designing how anonymous demand turns into qualified demand
* Think in journeys, logic, and behavioral signals
* Are deeply curious about what happens *before* a lead becomes “sales\-ready”
* Enjoy untangling messy funnels and building clean, scalable systems
* Can balance global frameworks with regional nuance and reality
* Are comfortable partnering with Sales without owning post\-MQL execution
* Value clarity, documentation, and governance as tools for speed and scale
* Influence effectively across brands, regions, and functions without direct authority

  

### **Core Skills \& Experience**


* Strong experience in demand generation operations, lead management, or marketing operations
* Hands\-on work with marketing automation platforms, lifecycle orchestration, and lead scoring
* Solid understanding of CRM concepts and MQL definitions, handoff logic, and governance
* Experience supporting multiple brands or regions within a shared demand generation model
* Analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose funnel issues and optimize performance through MQL
* Clear communicator in global, cross\-functional environments

  

### **Nice to Have**


* Experience with Eloqua (segmentation, nurture design, forms, integrations)
* Familiarity with customer interaction or omnichannel platforms (e.g., chat, messaging, call routing), preferred hands\-on experience with Genesys.
* Understanding of Salesforce lead objects and MQL handoff models
* Exposure to journey orchestration tools, chatbots, or AI\-assisted engagement
* Experience working with analytics or data platforms to support dark\-funnel visibility and attribution

title: Principal Country HR Partner - Fixed Term
description:
### **Strength in Trust**



OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down—it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

### **Strength in Trust**



OneTrust's mission is to enable organizations to use data and AI responsibly. Our platform simplifies collecting data with consent and preferences, automates data governance with integrated risk management across privacy, security, IT/tech, third\-party, and AI risk, and enables responsible data use by applying and enforcing data policies across the entire data estate and lifecycle. Recognized as a market pioneer and leader, OneTrust serves more than 14,000 customers globally.


### **The Challenge**



We are seeking a strategic, commercially minded Senior Principal / Director, HR Country Manager to serve as the HR leader for our Madrid office, our hub for the EMEA region. This role will be based in Madrid and will provide visible, on\-site leadership for the site while partnering closely with local leaders and global People stakeholders on both day\-to\-day operations and broader business strategy. The role combines executive partnership, strong operational and compliance oversight, and hands\-on support for complex people matters in Spain. This leader will also spend part of their time mentoring the current senior HR country leader to help strengthen their capability and develop toward a broader site leadership scope.


### **Your Mission**



To translate business strategy into a Spain people strategy that enables growth, leadership effectiveness, organizational health, compliance, and employee experience for the Madrid site and broader Spain employee population. This leader will ensure that OneTrust's global People philosophy is applied thoughtfully in Spain while advising leaders on local market realities, regulatory risk, workforce planning, and high\-impact people decisions.


### **You Are**



A seasoned HR leader with strong business acumen, sound judgment, and credibility with senior stakeholders. You bring deep expertise in Spanish employment law and labor practices, a track record of leading through complexity and change, and the ability to balance strategic influence with hands\-on execution. You are pragmatic, data\-driven, and comfortable operating as both a site\-level operator and a strategic business partner in a fast\-moving, multinational environment.


### **Main Tasks \& Responsibilities**


* Serve as the senior in\-person HR leader for Spain and the effective HR Manager for the Madrid site, acting as the primary advisor to local leaders on organizational strategy, people risk, workforce effectiveness, and leadership decision\-making.
* Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, talent strategy, retention priorities, and organizational change aligned to business goals.
* Translate global People strategies into Spain market execution that is legally compliant, culturally relevant, and operationally scalable, while ensuring strong partnership across People Business Partnership, People Operations, Payroll, HRIS, Total Rewards, Finance, and Legal.
* Lead complex employee relations, investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, restructures, and sensitive exits in Spain, including representing the company at SMAC conciliation proceedings where required and guiding leaders through legally informed decision\-making.
* Own Spain labor and statutory compliance across the employee lifecycle, including employment documentation, policy localization, working time and leave practices, separation requirements and execution, audit readiness, and compliance initiatives such as the establishment and ongoing governance of the Equality Plan for the Spanish entity.
* Identify and recommend policy, process, and controls updates to mitigate risk and maintain audit readiness.
* Provide strategic HR leadership for organizational changes, manager capability, team health, and culture, ensuring leaders are equipped to make fair, consistent, and business\-aligned people decisions.
* Use HR metrics and workforce analytics to identify trends, assess organizational health and compliance risk, and recommend actions to improve employee experience, manager effectiveness, and operational performance.
* Mentor the current HR country partner and local team to help broaden their capability and support their development toward stronger site leadership and support remits.

### **Minimum Education and Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree in HR, business, or a related field preferred.
* Deep knowledge of Spain employment law, labor practices, statutory compliance, and employee relations frameworks, including experience with sensitive exits, conciliation processes, and practical application of local requirements in a business setting.
* Direct experience leading Equality Plan design, implementation, governance, and related compliance initiatives within Spain, inclusive of a strong track record representing company interests with employee representative bodies.
* Strong experience with HRIS platforms and reporting tools; Workday strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical capability and comfort using data to influence executive decisions and improve HR effectiveness; professional HR certification is a plus.
* Fluency in Spanish and English required.

### **Background \& Experience**


* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience, including meaningful experience in senior HR leadership, HRBP, country HR, or director\-level roles.
* Experience as the leading HR partner for one or more offices is required.
* Proven experience leading complex employee relations, investigations, restructures, sensitive exits, and legally informed decision\-making.
* Strong track record of operating in Spain's regulatory environment and applying local requirements within a global or multinational company context.
* Experience leading or influencing cross\-functional teams and driving execution through ambiguity, scale, and change.
* Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and the ability to balance strategic leadership with operational rigor.

### **Where we Work**



We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.



Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.


### **Benefits**



As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.


### **Resources**

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:


* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

### **Your Data**



You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview**.** You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

  



Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.


### **Our Commitment to You**



When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

* Prepare monthly reports on social media for distribution to department heads and executive committee.
* Work closely with various departments to produce quality content for social media.
* Writing, commissioning, and editing materials for a range of key hotel audiences for use across all social media platforms.
* Plan, organize and oversee all social media photography / videography sessions.

Experience and education


* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, eCommerce Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2 years of solid experience in a similar role, preferably within the luxury hospitality sector (resort experience is considered a plus).
Technical Skills


* Excellent communication skills with an articulate and compelling communication style.
* Strong writing ability, capable of adapting tone and style to different audiences and communication platforms.
* Proven project management skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
* Creative mindset with the ability to think innovatively and work with flair and imagination.
* Strong communication skills in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

* Learning \& Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.

---------------

Here, you will be part of a high\-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------



We are looking for an Associate Director, Capability Building \& Change Management to own and drive communication, change management, internal branding, asset creation, and capability\-building activities as part of Global Procurement Transformation. This role will shape how teams understand transformation priorities, adopt new tools and ways of working, engage with AI\-enabled and technology\-driven change, and build the capabilities needed in a more digital, data\-driven, and agile procurement environment.


The successful candidate will work closely with procurement leaders, subject matter experts, digital teams, global L\&D, technology partners, and external providers to lead clear communication, practical change adoption, targeted learning enablement, and compelling transformation storytelling. The role will bring structure, pace, and ownership to change activities, connect the right experts, align priorities, create reusable communication and enablement assets, and ensure Global Procurement Transformation changes are understood, supported, branded consistently, and embedded over time.

**Location**
------------



Croatia, Spain or the Netherlands

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------


* **Own communication and stakeholder engagement for Global Procurement Transformation**
* Develop clear, audience\-relevant communication plans for Global Procurement Transformation priorities, initiatives, and activities.
* Translate complex business, process, and technology topics into simple messages that explain what is changing, why it matters, what support is available, and what actions are expected.
* Equip leaders and managers with messaging, materials, engagement moments, and communication assets that build understanding, confidence, and alignment.
* Develop communication assets, internal branding materials, launch narratives, leadership messages, FAQs, toolkits, and adoption content that create a consistent identity for procurement transformation and make change easier to understand and engage with.

* Support deployment of new procurement technologies and tools by shaping launch plans, adoption campaigns, readiness materials, and reinforcement activities that help users move from awareness to confident usage.
* Bring AI transformation into the change agenda by helping teams understand AI\-enabled use cases, responsible adoption expectations, capability needs, and practical examples of how AI can improve procurement work.

* Partner with transformation, digital, process, and procurement teams to embed new ways of working into day\-to\-day routines and sustain momentum.
* Drive reinforcement activities that encourage sustained usage, behavior change, and measurable adoption over time.
* **Support procurement capability building and learning enablement**
* Build and maintain a practical procurement capability roadmap aligned with Global Procurement Transformation priorities, business needs, and future skills requirements.
* Help identify priority capability gaps across technical, digital, data, communication, change, and soft skills.
* Partner with procurement subject matter experts and global L\&D to translate specialist knowledge into practical learning, playbooks, communication assets, and adoption materials.
* Create practical enablement assets such as playbooks, one\-pagers, launch packs, quick reference guides, demo scripts, user communications, and adoption toolkits for new tools, AI\-enabled solutions, and transformation initiatives.
* Coordinate learning and enablement activities that build confidence, strengthen adoption, and improve team effectiveness.
* **Track progress and drive continuous improvement**
* Track simple, meaningful indicators for learning participation, adoption, capability uplift, and business impact where measurable.
* Use feedback, usage data, and stakeholder input to continuously improve learning content, adoption support, and the overall user experience.
* Partner with global L\&D operations to manage learning logistics, platform activities, and reporting with clear ownership and follow\-through.

------------------------------


* Master’s degree preferred; relevant certification in change management, learning and development, project/program management, or procurement is an advantage.

* Ability to create clear communication plans and support change readiness, impact assessment, adoption planning, reinforcement, and measurement for new ways of working.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, audience\-relevant messages.
* Comfort working with digital tools, AI\-enabled technologies, data, Microsoft Office applications, collaboration platforms, learning technologies, and communication asset creation tools.

Strategic communication


* Support the development and delivery of communication strategies for global business initiatives

**Principal Security \& Detection Engineer**

*Title:* Principal Security \& Detection Engineer


*Job type:* Full\-Time Permanent


*Working arrangement:* 3 days a week onsite/hybrid.


*Salary:* Negotiable / DOE  



  

  

**About Us**

  

  

Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by seven Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Rome, Johannesburg and Cape Town.  



  

  

With over 780 employees, including more than 585 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid\-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.  



  

  

At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.  



  

  

  

  

**Job Role / Responsibilities**

  

  

As a **Principal Security \& Detection Engineer** , you will provide senior technical leadership across our Security Operations capability, with a particular focus on **detection engineering, security research, SOC automation, threat hunting, and the continued development of our fraud monitoring platform** .  



  

  

This is a highly technical role for an individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and taking ownership of complex technical problems from concept through to implementation.


You will operate as a senior member of the technical leadership team, helping define the direction of our detection and research capabilities while continuing to work hands\-on across security engineering, software development, research and automation.  



  

  

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable investigating how a new attack technique works, reproducing an exploit in a controlled environment, writing software to automate a security process, developing a new detection, and turning that work into a repeatable capability for the wider SOC.  



  

  

This is **not a traditional SOC monitoring or incident\-response role** . The focus is on building and improving the technology, methodologies and intelligence that enable the SOC to operate more effectively.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  

* **Detection Engineering \& Threat Hunting**
	+ Develop and maintain security detections across the technology stack.
	+ Execute hypothesis\-driven threat hunts and translate attacker TTPs into practical detections.
	+ Map capabilities to MITRE ATT\&CK and identify coverage gaps.
* **Fraud Monitoring Platform Development**
	+ Lead the development of the fraud and abuse monitoring platform.
	+ Design analytics, detection logic, and integrations to identify abuse patterns within business applications.
* **Security Automation \& SOAR**
	+ Design and develop automation to improve SOC efficiency.
	+ Build automated enrichment, investigation, and response workflows (SOAR playbooks).
* **Security Research \& Development**
	+ Conduct independent research into emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques.
	+ Reproduce exploits in a controlled environment to validate findings.

**Technical Leadership \& Autonomy**

* Provide technical leadership and establish standards for engineering activities.
* Conduct quality reviews and act as a senior technical decision\-maker.
Operate with a high degree of autonomy, owning projects from concept to implementation.  
* 

  

  

  

  

**Technical En** **vironment**

  

The successful candidate should be comfortable working across a broad security and software engineering environment, including:


* SIEM
* EDR/XDR technologies
* SOAR and security automation
* Threat hunting
* Vulnerability research and exploitation
* Network security and networking technologies
* Python
* SQL
APIs and system integrations  
* 

  

  

**Required Experience \& Skills**

* Minimum 3 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, software development, or a combination of both with a strong security focus.
* Demonstrated experience developing software, automation or security tooling.
* Strong Python development capability.
* Strong understanding of security monitoring and detection engineering.
* Experience working with SIEM, security analytics and large\-scale security telemetry.
* Experience designing and developing integrations between security platforms and other systems.
* Strong understanding of networking and network security principles.
* Ability to translate security research into practical detections, automation or engineering solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated initiative and a willingness to research unfamiliar technologies and problems.
Ability to manage multiple technical projects and prioritise work effectively.  
* 

  

  

**Certifications/Qualifications**

* A relevant **degree, diploma or equivalent formal qualification** is preferred.
* However, demonstrated professional experience and technical capability will be considered equally important. Candidates who can demonstrate strong practical cybersecurity or software\-development experience without a traditional academic background will be considered.
* **Industry certifications are not a primary requirement for this position.** Demonstrated technical ability, initiative, engineering capability and practical experience are more important.

title: Head of Global Partnership
description:
**At** **Lexroom** **we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust.**


In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by **thousands of legal professionals across Europe**.


Our mission is clear: **make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable**, giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.


We’re scaling rapidly, backed by top\-tier investors and a world\-class team dedicated to rigor, clarity, and impact.


Today, Lexroom is a **trusted partner**, shaping the future of legal AI with discipline and purpose.

  

**Why** **Lexroom****?**
------------------------

* **Shape the Standard:** Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.
* **Work with the Best:** Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.
* **Deliver Meaningful Results:** Your contribution will directly influence how legal professionals work—faster, clearer, and more efficiently.


At **Lexroom**, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: **a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.**

  

**Role**
--------

**Lexroom** is building its partnership channel from close to zero and wants it to become a material driver of revenue growth. You will own that channel end to end: strategic reselling and co\-sell relationships with big consulting firms and system integrators, large enterprise accounts, and early\-stage product partnerships as our API surface develops. You will define the operating model, prove it in market, and build the team that scales it across our European footprint.


This is a build\-from\-scratch leadership seat reporting directly to our CRO and co\-founder, not a role inheriting an established motion.

**Your key responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* **Channel design and ownership**: design the partnership channel and build it into a material revenue driver, owning co\-sell and revenue\-share relationships end to end.
* **Operating model**: define whether and how partnership closes its own revenue versus feeds the sales pipeline, and build the case, grounded in data, for the model you back.
* **Relationship ownership**: personally run Lexroom's most valuable strategic relationships, from prospecting through signature.
* **Playbook design**: build repeatable processes for partner sourcing, qualification, engagement rules, and co\-sell motion from the ground up.
* **Team building**: hire and lead country partnership leads and associates as deal volume justifies.
* **Partner enablement and certification**: build training, certification, and co\-marketing materials that let partners sell and implement independently over time.
* **Tooling and attribution**: define the partner\-source model in the CRM, own the deal registration policy, and track partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline with the discipline of a revenue function, not a marketing one.
* **Performance management and partner reviews**: define KPIs (pipeline generated, ARR sourced or influenced, logos activated), build dashboards, and run structured quarterly business reviews with strategic partners.
* **Cross\-functional alignment**: agree lead handoff and attribution rules with Sales leaders, work with Finance and Legal on commission and revenue\-share structures, and scope product\-partnership opportunities with Product.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **Partnership leadership track record**: 7\+ years in business development, alliances, or channel roles in B2B SaaS, including at least 3 years owning revenue\-accountable relationships with system integrators or consulting partners in an enterprise or mid\-market context. Ideally you have built a partnership motion from an early stage rather than inherited one at scale.
* **Complex deal negotiation**: the commercial rigour to structure and close revenue\-share and co\-sell agreements with Big 4 firms and system integrators, including multi\-stakeholder, long\-cycle negotiations. Familiarity with frameworks such as MEDDICC or Challenger Sale is a plus.
* **Builder mindset, not a maintainer**: comfortable building playbooks, attribution models, and team rituals from scratch in a function where most of the infrastructure does not exist yet.
* **International experience**: you have built or managed partnership relationships across multiple European markets. You know a playbook that works in one country rarely transfers unchanged, and you adjust commercial terms and positioning accordingly.
* **Commercial and analytical judgment**: able to structure and negotiate commission and revenue\-share terms, build pipeline and ARR forecasting for partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced deals, and make prioritisation calls on which partners and deals to pursue, grounded in data.
* **Languages**: fluent English is required, plus professional fluency in at least one of Italian, French, Spanish, or German. Additional European languages are a plus.

**Rewarding your contribution**
-------------------------------

* **Compensation (Milan equivalent)**: €120,000–160,000 OTE
* **Equity**: meaningful equity on top, in line with the seniority of the role
* **Team retreats \& off\-sites**: dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas

 **At Lexroom, ambition meets discipline and purpose.**


We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.


Compensation Range: €120K \- €160K

title: Customer Success Manager - Madrid (F/M/X)
description:
Madrid  

Permanent contract · Start date: ASAP  

International environment

**Do you enjoy taking ownership, solving problems, and building things from scratch?**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


At Combo, we're looking for our next **Customer Success Manager to take care of our Spanish market**.


Spain is a strategic market for Combo. We already have an established local Sales team and a growing customer base. Our next challenge is to continue structuring our Customer Success approach while ensuring our Spanish customers get the support and experience they need to succeed with Combo.


This is a highly hands\-on and operational role.


You won't simply manage a portfolio of customers. You'll take ownership of their overall experience: from supporting key accounts to handling day\-to\-day requests, while also building scalable processes that will allow us to grow.

**More than 150,000 employees use Combo every day.**
----------------------------------------------------


To check their schedules. Track their hours. Manage their teams.


At Combo, we build HR solutions for companies with deskless teams: restaurants, hotels, retailers, pharmacies, bakeries, sports and leisure businesses, and more.


The adventure started in 2016 with a simple idea: making HR easier for businesses and the people who run them.


Today, thousands of companies across Europe rely on Combo to simplify their day\-to\-day HR operations.


Our platform brings together the tools teams need every day: scheduling, contract management, payroll preparation, team communication, and productivity tracking.


And we're still growing.

**Your role**
-------------


You'll be the main point of contact and advocate for our Spanish customers.


Your mission is simple: help them get the most out of Combo while building a Customer Success approach that can scale with our business.


The role combines **Account Management, Customer Success, Customer Care, and continuous improvement**.

### **You'll support our customers every day**


You'll build strong and trusted relationships with our key accounts and help them get the most value from Combo.


You'll also handle more operational requests from customers with speed, empathy, and pragmatism.


You'll become a key point of contact for our Spanish customers and make sure every interaction with Combo leads to a clear and useful outcome.

### **You'll build processes that can scale**


Not every customer needs the same level of support.


For our key accounts, you'll provide a more personalised and proactive approach.


For the rest of our customer base, you'll design and implement scalable ways to provide value: webinars, communication campaigns, automated sequences, content, Help Center articles, and more.


The goal? Deliver the right level of support at the right time, without relying exclusively on manual interactions.


You'll identify friction points throughout the customer journey and find practical ways to simplify and automate recurring interactions.

### **You'll keep a close eye on customer health**


You'll maintain a clear understanding of your customer base.


Product usage, engagement, satisfaction, churn risks: you'll know where to look and how to interpret the signals.


You'll identify potential risks early and implement concrete action plans to prevent churn.


Data quality is essential in this role. Your CRM will be reliable, your customer information up to date, and your tracking rigorous enough to give the wider team a clear view of what's happening.

### **You'll bring the voice of the Spanish market to Combo**


You'll be close to our Spanish customers.


Their feedback, frustrations, and needs will be valuable insights for the rest of Combo.


You'll structure this feedback and turn it into clear, actionable insights for our Product and Operations teams.


Your role won't simply be to forward customer requests.


You'll help us understand what's really happening on the ground and what our Spanish customers need.

**This role is made for you if...**
-----------------------------------


You have at least **2 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Support**, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.


You've already worked with customers requiring different levels of support and are comfortable combining **High Touch and scalable, Low Touch approaches**.


You're a natural problem solver.


When something isn't working perfectly, your first instinct is to understand the situation and find a practical solution.


You don't need every process to already exist before moving forward. You're comfortable structuring, testing, and building things.


You're autonomous, organised, and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment.


You care about the quality of your work, especially when it comes to customer follow\-up and data. For you, keeping a clean and reliable CRM isn't just a detail.


You're also comfortable with numbers and able to understand topics related to HR or payroll.


And most importantly:


**You're a native or fully fluent Spanish speaker**, both written and spoken.


**You're fluent in English**, as you'll work daily with your manager and international teams.


French is a strong plus, but not a requirement.

**Why join Combo?**
-------------------


Because you won't be joining a Customer Success organisation where everything has already been figured out.


You'll have a customer base to support, but also plenty of things to build.


You'll have a real impact on how we support our Spanish customers: improving processes, structuring data, creating playbooks, and testing new approaches.


You'll work closely with our Spanish Sales team while also being part of an international Customer Success organisation.


This is a role for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in fast\-moving environments, and gets just as much satisfaction from solving a customer problem as from building a process that prevents it from happening again.

**What we offer**
-----------------


**A gross annual fixed salary between €34K and €41K**, depending on your experience.


And also:

* **Stock options** once your probation period has been successfully completed
* ️ **Meal vouchers**
* **A 40\-hour working week**
* A role based in our **Madrid office**
* An international environment, working closely with teams in France
* A high\-impact role with real ownership over a strategic market and customer base
* ️ The opportunity to build, structure, and improve the way we support our customers in Spain
* A close\-knit local Sales team, backed by an established and growing European scale\-up
* Plenty of autonomy and room to make an impact

**Our hiring process**
----------------------

**Step 1 – HR Screening (30 min)**


A first conversation with **Thomas, Talent Acquisition Manager**, to get to know each other, tell you more about Combo, and discuss your experience and expectations.

**Step 2 – Management Fit (60 min)**


A conversation with **Estelle, Head of Customer Success**, to discuss the role in more detail, your experience, and how you approach Customer Success and customer management.

**Step 3 – Skill Test**


A practical exercise designed to better understand how you approach real\-life situations you could face in the role.

**Step 4 – Culture Fit**


A final meeting at our **Madrid office**, where you'll get to meet the team and learn more about how we work at Combo.

**Our commitment**
------------------


At Combo, we believe diverse teams make better decisions, build better products, and create stronger companies.


We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and grow.

They are our guiding principles; internal agreements we make as a CorePower team about how we interact with each other and our students. Living our core values means they guide all our activities, define our workplace culture, and ensure there are no missed opportunities to fulfill our higher purpose.


We embrace our differences and foster an inclusive space where everyone can reach their full potential. We uplift, inspire and guide one another. We make time to share the power of yoga together, celebrate milestones and find joy in the present moment.


**ROLE SUMMARY**  

The Director, Real Estate is the driving force behind CorePower Yoga's real estate growth strategy and the ongoing health of our existing portfolio. This role owns annual market planning and site selection strategy, leads a team who does negotiations for new deals and lease renewals, and manages a portfolio of 213 studios including renewals, relocations, and closures. As the quarterback of every new deal, the Director partners closely with Design, Construction, outside brokers, and landlords to take sites from initial identification through grand opening. This is a highly analytical, relationship\-driven role that requires the ability to translate market data into a compelling growth story for executive leadership, while also serving as a passionate ambassador for the CorePower Yoga brand and the benefits of a yoga\-centered lifestyle. The Director will lead and develop a team of three direct reports. CorePower Yoga anticipates growing at 25\+ new studios/year into coming years.  



**ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIE** **S**

**Growth Strategy \& Market Planning**

* Lead annual market planning process, identifying and prioritizing target markets and trade areas aligned with CorePower Yoga's growth objectives.
* Own delivery against annual growth commitments, including new studio openings, relocations, and portfolio optimization targets
* Develop and maintain a data\-driven site selection framework, incorporating demographic, lifestyle, and competitive analysis.
* Present market plans, growth pipelines, and portfolio performance to executive leadership on a regular cadence.
* Strong Financial acumen including navigating proformas, studio level financials and financial terms for deal trade offs with ease.

**Portfolio Management**

* Manage the full 213\-studio portfolio, proactively evaluating each location's performance and lease position.
* Lead lease renewal strategy and negotiations across the portfolio, balancing financial performance with brand and market presence.
* Identify and execute studio relocations and closures where warranted by market, financial, or lease conditions.
* Create and maintain standardized templates and playbooks for LOIs, leases, and market plans to drive consistency and efficiency across the team.

**Deal Execution \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the quarterback for all new deals, from site identification and underwriting through lease execution, construction, and grand opening.
* Negotiate letters of intent and lease agreements directly with landlords and brokers, securing terms that support long\-term studio profitability.
* Partner closely with Design and Construction teams to ensure sites are delivered on time, on budget, and true to the CorePower Yoga brand experience.
* Manage relationships with a network of outside brokers and landlords, representing CorePower Yoga as a preferred tenant and partner.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of direct reports, setting clear priorities and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture.
* Build team capabilities in market analysis, deal negotiation, and portfolio management.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 7–10 years of real estate experience within a multi\-unit, multi\-location retail, restaurant, or fitness brand.
* Proven track record managing a large studio/store portfolio, including lease renewals, relocations, and closures.
* Demonstrated success leading site selection and market planning for a growing brand.
* Strong lease negotiation experience, with direct dealings with landlords and brokers.
* Highly analytical, with the ability to gather, synthesize, and present complex data to executive leadership.
* Experience managing and developing a team; strong people\-leadership skills.
* Excellent storytelling and communication skills — able to bring the CorePower Yoga brand and the benefits of yoga to life for external partners.
* Comfortable operating cross\-functionally with Design, Construction, Finance, and Operations.
* Bachelor's degree required

Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40%.  

* 

  

**COMPENSATION**

* Annual Salary: $135,000\-$150,000 based on experience
20% Bonus  
* 

  

**WORK LOCATION**

* Remote working opportunity. Must reside in a state with current CorePower Yoga operations

**THE PERKS**

* Free All Access Membership \- use anytime, in studio or online
* Free All Access Membership for a Plus One \- bring someone along!
* Retail Discounts
* Continued Education Offerings
* Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Comprehensive Health Insurance \- available for eligible employees
* Generous PTO Policy
* Expanded Holiday Calendar
* Quarterly Wellness Days

WHO WE ARE


At CorePower Yoga, we live our power by showing the world the incredible life\-changing things that happen when you root an intensely physical workout in the mindfulness of yoga. This is our promise. We are the nation’s largest yoga studio brand with over 200 locations across the country, digital livestream and on\-demand classes, and thousands of passionate yoga teachers sharing the transformative power of our practice.  



As a team, we love seeing the magic that happens in a CorePower Yoga class when physical meets mindful and strive to create a work environment that mirrors the balance, empowerment and community experienced in our yoga studios.

title: Director, Customer Success
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

**So, what’s the role all about?**
----------------------------------



We are looking for an exceptional Customer Success leader to lead and elevate a global team of approximately 26 Customer Success Managers across Australia, the US, UK, Germany and the wider EMEA region.



This is a senior leadership role for someone who knows what great Customer Success looks like and has the experience, credibility and energy to build it at scale. You will set the global Customer Success strategy, establish a clear and scalable operating model, raise standards across regions and develop our CSMs into consistently stronger strategic customer leaders.



This is deliberately **not an account owning role**. You will not carry your own customer portfolio. Instead, you will operate as a strategic leader, coach and expert across the Customer Success organisation, providing direction, challenge and expertise across Customer Success strategy, methodology, processes, commercial discipline, customer value and team performance.



You will bring consistency to a geographically distributed organisation while recognising that different markets and customers require different approaches. You will challenge existing thinking, raise the bar and create an environment where CSMs are accountable for delivering measurable customer and business outcomes.



Working closely with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Support, Engineering and senior leadership, you will play a critical role in ensuring Customer Success is positioned as a strategic function and a key driver of customer value, retention and growth.


**How will you make an impact?**
--------------------------------


* Lead, coach and develop a global team of approximately 26 Customer Success Managers across Australia, the US, UK, Germany and the wider EMEA region, creating a high performance, accountable and collaborative culture.
* Set the global Customer Success strategy and translate it into clear priorities, standards and measurable outcomes that can be consistently understood and executed across regions.
* Own and continuously evolve the global Customer Success methodology, operating model, processes, governance, tooling and best practices, ensuring they remain effective as the organisation scales.
* Establish a consistent framework for customer planning, onboarding, adoption, value realisation, customer health, risk identification, renewals and expansion, working closely with Sales to ensure clear ownership and collaboration.
* Coach CSMs to become stronger strategic customer leaders, developing their capabilities across executive engagement, commercial acumen, value selling, stakeholder management, strategic account planning and effective customer conversations.
* Provide constructive challenge to CSMs and regional leaders, raising the quality and consistency of customer strategy and ensuring teams are focused on meaningful customer and business outcomes rather than simply completing activities.
* Establish clear performance expectations, KPIs and management rhythms across Customer Success, using data and customer insight to identify trends, diagnose performance gaps and uncover opportunities for improvement.
* Build and maintain a strong Customer Success knowledge base, including playbooks, frameworks, templates and repeatable practices that enable CSMs to operate effectively and consistently.
* Partner closely with Sales leadership to establish effective collaboration across renewals, expansion, customer risk and executive relationships, ensuring Customer Success maintains its strategic customer focus without becoming a sales function.
* Partner with Professional Services, Product, Support and Engineering to improve the end to end customer experience, identify recurring sources of friction and drive improvements across the customer lifecycle.
* Act as a senior escalation point for strategically important or complex customer situations, providing direction, coaching and strategic guidance to the CSM rather than taking over account ownership.
* Represent the voice of Customer Success at senior leadership level, bringing clear customer insight, recommendations and data driven perspectives to business decisions.
* Identify capability gaps across the organisation and build targeted development plans, coaching programmes and succession pipelines to strengthen the long term capability of the Customer Success function.
* Support hiring and organisational design decisions as the Customer Success organisation continues to grow, ensuring we have the right structure, capabilities and leadership in place for scale.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and customer value, encouraging the team to challenge established thinking and continually raise the standard of Customer Success.

**Have you got what it takes?**
-------------------------------


* Significant senior leadership experience within Customer Success, ideally gained in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, AI, automation or a similarly complex technology environment.
* Proven experience leading geographically distributed Customer Success teams, ideally at a scale comparable to 20\+ CSMs across multiple regions and markets.
* Deep expertise in Customer Success strategy, operating models, methodologies, processes, tooling, governance and performance management.
* A strong track record of coaching and developing Customer Success Managers and building high performing teams.
* Experience establishing, transforming or scaling Customer Success processes and standards during periods of significant growth or organisational change.
* A strong understanding of customer value realisation, product adoption, retention, renewals, expansion, customer health and executive engagement.
* Strong commercial understanding, with the ability to partner effectively with Sales and understand the commercial drivers of the business without turning Customer Success into a sales function.
* Highly data driven, with the ability to use customer and business insight to diagnose performance, identify risk, establish priorities and make informed decisions.
* Exceptional executive communication and influencing skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior stakeholders, challenge established thinking and communicate complex ideas clearly.
* An exceptional coach who can elevate CSM performance through clear, practical guidance, constructive challenge and strong leadership.
* Strategic and structured, with the ability to operate at a global level while diving into the detail when required.
* Strong judgement and commercial acumen, with a clear focus on measurable outcomes and the ability to balance customer, commercial and organisational priorities.
* Collaborative, pragmatic and confident. You are comfortable challenging established thinking while building strong relationships across functions and levels of seniority.
* Calm, credible and highly organised, particularly when dealing with complex customer situations, competing priorities and high pressure environments.
* Able to create clarity, align distributed teams and lead effectively through periods of change.
* Naturally curious about customers, technology and the ways organisations can use AI and automation to generate measurable business value.

**How will we measure success?**
--------------------------------



Success in this role will be measured through a combination of customer, commercial, organisational and team outcomes, including:


* Achievement of Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Gross Retention Revenue (GRR) and NPS targets established at the start of each financial year.
* Customer satisfaction, advocacy and the strength of strategic customer relationships.
* Improved customer time to value and measurable value realisation from Cognigy solutions.
* CSM performance, capability development, engagement and retention.
* Consistent adoption and effective execution of the global Customer Success methodology.
* The quality, scalability and effectiveness of Customer Success processes, playbooks, governance and operating rhythms.
* Reduction in preventable customer risk, escalations and recurring sources of customer friction.
* Stronger cross functional collaboration and execution across Customer Success, Sales, Professional Services, Product, Support and Engineering.


Ultimately, success means building a Customer Success organisation that is highly trusted by our customers, commercially effective, operationally consistent and capable of scaling with the business.


**What’s in it for you?**
-------------------------



Join an ever growing, market disrupting global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast paced, collaborative and creative environment.



At NiCE, every day is an opportunity to learn, grow and make an impact. As the market leader, there are endless internal career opportunities across roles, disciplines, domains and locations.



If you are passionate about Customer Success, excited by the potential of AI and motivated by the opportunity to build and lead a truly global organisation, you may just be our next NICEr!


**About Cognigy**

NiCE Cognigy delivers AI that works, fast, human and enterprise ready. As the leading AI first CX platform built for real world scale, we combine Generative and Conversational AI through orchestration, tools and enterprise systems to power Agentic AI.



Backed by global CX leader NiCE, we empower brands with AI Agents that redefine customer experiences and achieve measurable ROI, instantly, across every channel and in 100\+ languages.

description:

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.
  

  

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side\-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.
  

  

Are you ready to make your impact?


**About The Role**


Our Corporate Positioning \& Insights (CPI\&I) practice is seeking a Paid Media Director to develop and execute paid media and digital strategy based on data\-driven insights. This role will be an important contributor to accounts covering ongoing corporate brand positioning, public affairs campaigns, crisis response and special situations.


In this role, the candidate will have the opportunity to work directly with clients across a range of sectors, as a key contributor to strategy and delivery, as well as helping to position our firm through thought leadership and contributions to generating new business. The role will develop in\-depth knowledge of client objectives and challenges and bring expertise in paid media strategy to bear on fast\-moving, news\-shaping client engagements.


**What You’ll Do**


Paid Media Strategy \& Execution


* Lead the end\-to\-end management of paid media campaigns across channels including paid search (Google, Bing, ChatGPT), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, X/Twitter), programmatic display, video/CTV, and out of home from briefing through to post\-campaign analysis.
* Translate client business objectives and communications strategies into actionable paid media plans, including audience segmentation, channel selection, budget allocation, and KPI frameworks.
* Conceptualize and oversee creative concepting and copy requirements for paid activations, collaborating with creative and content colleagues to ensure messaging alignment.
* Own campaign trafficking, tagging, and QA processes to ensure accurate tracking and attribution across all paid programs.
* Manage campaign budgets with rigor, maintaining pacing reports and proactively flagging optimization opportunities or risks to senior team members and clients.

Client \& Account Management


* Serve as a primary day\-to\-day client contact on paid media accounts, communicating clearly and proactively with clients on campaign status, performance, and strategic direction.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with colleagues across Corporate Positioning \& Insights and wider Strategic Communications practices—including public affairs, financial communications, crisis management and corporate reputation—to deliver integrated, multi\-channel communications programs.
* Contribute to the development of client scopes, proposals, and presentations, articulating paid media strategy and measurement frameworks to senior audiences.
* Support new business development efforts by contributing paid media expertise to pitches and credential documents.

Team \& Practice Development


* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior analysts and associates, reviewing their work and supporting their development in paid media craft.
* Contribute to Corporate Positioning \& Insights' internal knowledge\-sharing, staying current on platform updates, industry tools, and emerging best practices and disseminating insights to the broader team.
* Assist in establishing and refining team processes, workflow standards, and quality\-control frameworks for paid media delivery.

**How You’ll Grow**


We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development. We have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on\-the\-job learning, self\-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth. As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.


**What You Will Need To Succeed**


Basic Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Political Science, Business, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on paid media experience, ideally within a communications agency, public affairs firm, or digital consultancy.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing paid campaigns across paid search (Google Ads), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), and programmatic display platforms.
* Proficiency in campaign measurement and analytics tools, including Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Tag Manager, and native platform reporting.
* Experience with listening and monitoring tools such as Brandwatch, Meltwater and Signal AI, with proficiency in building queries using Boolean logic and establishing dashboards for reputation tracking.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data sets into clear, client\-ready narrative and recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior client stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines simultaneously in a fast\-paced, high\-stakes environment.
* Ability to travel to FTI office(s) and client site as needed
* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States for any employer on a full\-time basis; this position does not provide visa sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience in B2B or public affairs paid media, including issue advocacy, corporate reputation, or financial communications campaigns.
* Familiarity with DSPs and programmatic buying platforms.
* Experience with CTV/OTT media planning and buying.
* Working knowledge of data visualization and dashboarding tools
* Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, or other relevant platform certifications.
* Experience with audience research, social listening, and media intelligence tools (e.g., Brandwatch, Meltwater, Sprinklr).
* Familiarity with SEO, search strategy, AI\-powered search, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and evolving digital discovery trends.
