title: Director, Creative Services - Pottery Barn
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Photo Direction Team**
 Housed within Pottery Barn’s Creative department, the Photo Direction team translates the brand’s creative
   

  

 vision into compelling photography and videography that inspires our customers to decorate, entertain, and
   

  

 live beautifully in a home that reflects their individual style.
   

  

 Supporting Pottery Barn’s omni\-channel business, the team concepts, develops and executes the photographic vision for each season, creating beautiful, distinctive and consistently on\-brand imagery across digital, social, print, marketing, advertising and in\-store channels. We foster a highly collaborative, creative and positive environment and partner closely across Creative, Product Development, Merchandising, E\-Commerce, Video and Social Media.
   

  

**Overview Of The Creative Director Role**
 The Creative Director is a senior creative leader responsible for driving and creating Pottery Barn’s seasonal
   

  

 photographic vision, ensuring that the brand’s visual expression is distinctive, inspiring and consistent
   

  

 across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 Working closely with the Senior Vice President of Creative and Vice President of Creative and Photography,
   

  

 the Creative Director translates brand, product and seasonal direction into compelling visual concepts and
   

  

 establishes the creative framework that guides photography, video and related content.
   

  

 This role sees the big picture and is also responsible for executing the details. You are a
   

  

 sophisticated visual storyteller with a strong point of view on interiors, decorating, photography, styling and
   

  

 culture—and understand where Pottery Barn sits in that intersection.
   

  

 You also understand how to translate product and brand ideas into imagery that creates emotion,
   

  

 communicates a clear point of view and ultimately builds desire for the Pottery Barn brand. You have the ability to
   

  

 create compelling individual images while simultaneously knowing how to create cohesive images that form a campaign.
   

  

 The Creative Director leads and inspires Art Directors and extended creative teams while partnering with
   

  

 photographers, stylists, producers, set designers and cross\-functional leaders to bring seasonal campaigns
   

  

 and ongoing brand storytelling to life.
   

  

 You will report to the Vice President, Creative and Photography and work closely with the Senior Vice
   

  

 President of Creative.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with the SVP and VP of Creative to establish the overarching photographic and visual direction for seasonal campaigns, brand initiatives and key storytelling moments.
* Participate in seasonal concept showroom walk\-throughs and Product Development meetings to understand the product vision, key stories and priorities for each season.
* Translate seasonal product and brand direction into a clear creative vision that establishes the overall mood, storytelling approach, visual language and photographic point of view.
* With oversight from Vice President, Creative and Photography, lead the development and review of seasonal Creative Briefs, ensuring concepts reflect the intended brand vision and provide clear direction for Art Directors, photographers, stylists, producers and other creative partners.
* Establish and maintain Pottery Barn's photographic standards and overall visual "look and feel," ensuring consistency while continually evolving the brand's imagery.
* Provide creative leadership across multiple campaigns, shoots and seasonal chapters, maintaining a holistic view of how individual assets work together to create a cohesive customer experience.
* Guide Art Directors in developing decorating concepts, styling direction, camera approaches, lighting, set design and other visual elements that bring the approved creative direction to life.
* Partner with the VP Creative on photographer, stylist and creative talent selection based on the needs and visual objectives of each campaign.
* Review and guide set concepts and environmental storytelling to ensure rooms and spaces communicate a strong Pottery Barn point of view and appropriately showcase product.
* Provide senior\-level creative direction during key photography and video shoots, guiding mood, tone, composition, lighting, styling and overall visual execution.
* Inspire and develop Art Directors and broader creative teams, providing clear feedback, mentorship and creative guidance while fostering a collaborative and high\-performing environment.
* Build productive creative partnerships with photographers, stylists, producers, digital artists, set builders and other external and internal creative talent.
* Partner closely with Merchandising and Product Development to ensure creative storytelling and product representation are aligned while maintaining the integrity of the creative vision.
* Collaborate with E\-Commerce, Social, Video, Marketing and other channel partners to ensure the photographic vision translates effectively across customer touchpoints.
* Partner with Pagination and Creative teams to ensure imagery supports compelling layouts, storytelling and seasonal content needs.
* Review photography and video throughout the creative process, providing senior\-level direction on image selection, color, retouching, backgrounds, cropping, layouts and overall visual consistency.
* Anticipate creative challenges and proactively identify solutions that balance brand vision, product priorities, production realities and business needs.
* Champion a culture of creativity, collaboration, curiosity and excellence while helping evolve Pottery Barn's visual expression and brand relevance.


**Criteria**
* Undergraduate or graduate degree in a visual or creative discipline such as advertising, interior design, interior architecture, graphic design, fine art or photography.
* Significant progressive creative leadership experience within photography, art direction, styling, editorial, advertising or related visual disciplines.
* Deep experience within home furnishings, lifestyle, interiors, retail, editorial or a similarly design\-driven industry strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate an overarching creative vision and translate brand\-level concepts into compelling visual storytelling.
* Exceptional visual judgment with a sophisticated understanding of interiors, decorating, styling, composition, photography, color and design.
* Proven ability to lead, inspire and develop Art Directors and multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Experience directing photographers, stylists, producers, digital artists, set builders and other creative partners.
* Strong conceptual thinker who can move fluidly between high\-level creative strategy and detailed visual execution.
* Ability to articulate creative ideas clearly and persuasively to creative teams, cross\-functional partners and senior executives.
* Highly collaborative, with demonstrated success partnering across Product Development, Merchandising, E\-Commerce, Social, Video and other functions.
* Resourceful and solutions\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple creative initiatives and changing priorities while maintaining a consistently high visual standard.
* Strong understanding of the home furnishings and décor landscape with knowledge of current and emerging trends in interiors, photography, design and culture.
* Proven proficiency working within a digital\-first creative environment, including familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and contemporary creative workflows.
* Above all, you bring exceptional taste, strong creative instincts and a clear point of view, paired with the leadership skills to inspire others and translate Pottery Barn's brand vision into imagery that feels relevant, beautiful and unmistakably Pottery Barn.


**Our Culture \& Values**
 We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.
   

  

**People First**
 Putting People First means investing in overall well\-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:
   

  

**Benefits**
* A generous discount on all WSI brands
* A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities
* Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer
* Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same\-sex domestic partner benefits
* Tax\-free commuter benefits
* A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


**Continued Learning**
* In\-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University
* Cross\-brand and cross\-function career opportunities
* Resources for self\-development
* Advisor (Mentor) program
* Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series

 Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.
   

  

 The expected starting pay range for this position is $140,000\-$175,000\. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job\-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.
   

  

**About Us**
 Our Company
   

  

 Founded in 1956, Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high\-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark \& Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully\-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick\-and\-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high\-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi\-brand, multi\-channel, global enterprise supported by state\-of\-the\-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing \- and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

title: Business Operations Associate, Temp to Perm
description:
**This role will start as a 1099 contractor for 90 days and then have the opportunity to go full time.**
**The role is open to US, Canada, and Western Europe ONLY.**

**About TNT Growth**
===========================================================================================================================================================================================


TNT Growth is a performance marketing agency operating at the intersection of growth strategy, paid media, and creative production for DTC and B2B brands. We’re a remote\-first team of 30\+ people running on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) and building the operational infrastructure to scale.

**About This Role**
===================


We’re hiring a Business Operations Associate to join our team on a contract\-to\-hire basis. This role has two phases:

**Phase 1 (Weeks 1–12\):** You’ll serve as interim operational coverage during a planned leadership leave, working directly with the CEO and department leads across finance, people operations, and company operations. This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility period where you’ll keep critical business functions running smoothly.

**Phase 2 (Ongoing):** Once the leave period ends, the role transitions to its permanent scope — owning the day\-to\-day of people operations support, project management, operational reporting, and cross\-functional coordination. If the contract goes well, you convert to full\-time with an expanded seat on the business operations team.

**Phase 1: Interim Responsibilities (Weeks 1–12\)**
===================================================


During the leave period, you will be the operational point person across finance and company operations. The CEO will retain final decision\-making authority, but you are responsible for the day\-to\-day execution, triage, and follow\-through.

**Finance Operations**

* **Contractor invoice review:** Review incoming contractor invoices against the financial forecast. Flag discrepancies, missing costs, or new vendors not yet in projections to Finance and escalate to the CEO as needed.
* **Cost tracker oversight:** Periodically review the cost tracker for accuracy. Verify invoice numbers, identify unbilled client costs, and flag billing discrepancies (e.g., clients being served without signed agreements or deposits on file).
* **Subscription and credit card management:** Maintain the master list of software subscriptions across all departments — tracking which tool is on which card and who owns it. Catch orphaned subscriptions, duplicate tools, and charges on the wrong card. Coordinate card migrations when team members depart or change roles.
* **Headcount and software request triage:** Monitor the automated approval workflow in Slack for new headcount and software purchase requests. Ensure business cases are complete and route to Finance and the CEO for approval. Work with people \& talent lead to determine salary range for roles.
* **Finance meeting support:** Help prepare for and support periodic finance review meetings. Track action items, follow up on open billing issues, and ensure recurring reviews happen on schedule.
* **End\-of\-quarter and year\-end support:** Assist Finance with quarterly close activities and budget reconciliation. Support year\-end planning by gathering data, tracking deadlines, and coordinating across departments.

**Company Operations**

* **Executive meeting support:** Prepare agendas, track action items, and maintain documentation for the weekly executive meeting. Ensure follow\-through on decisions made in leadership meetings.
* **Operating system support:** Help maintain and reinforce the company’s EOS implementation — ensure scorecard data is updated, rocks are tracked, and meeting cadences are followed across departments.
* **Contract management support:** Support Client Success and Sales with active contract management — tracking signature status on addendums, SOWs, and new agreements. Flag renewals and ensure in\-progress contracts don’t stall.
* **End\-of\-year performance planning:** Work with the CEO and executive team to determine what end\-of\-year performance evaluation looks like and support the planning process.
* **Cross\-department coordination:** Serve as the operational connective tissue between Finance, People Ops, Client Success, and department leads. Triage incoming operational requests and route them to the right owner.
* **Performance review execution:** Partner with the People \& Talent Lead to execute the end\-of\-year performance review cycle — coordinating timelines, compiling self\-assessments and manager feedback, and ensuring reviews are completed on schedule across all departments.

**Phase 2: Ongoing Responsibilities**
=====================================


After the leave period, this role settles into its permanent scope. You’ll continue to own and build on the areas below as the company scales.

**People Operations**

* **Headcount approval coordination:** Guide new headcount requests from reviewing the business case through budget approval to confirming the job description with People Operations/Recruiting. Ensure requests are complete and well\-documented before routing to Finance and the CEO for final sign\-off.
* **Offboarding support:** Assist with managing offboarding checklists in ClickUp as needed — coordinating system access removal, Gusto deactivation, and final day logistics.
* **Payroll support:** Work with Finance to add new hires to payroll, ensuring accurate start dates, compensation, and classification. Not all team members are on Gusto — coordinate across platforms for global employees.
* **SOP and policy development:** Assist People Operations with the creation of new standard operating procedures and company policies as needs arise.
* **Training material review:** Review and offer insight on training slide decks and materials created by People Operations, ensuring accuracy and alignment with company standards.
* **Hiring coordination:** Work with the People Operations/Talent Lead to keep the hiring pipeline moving — ensure job descriptions are finalized, interviews are scheduled, and offers are issued promptly once approved.
* **Onboarding support:** Support People Operations with new hire onboarding logistics including system access setup, Slack workspace invitations, and first\-day materials.
* **Performance review preparation:** Own the operational preparation for performance review cycles, including compiling self\-assessments, coordinating manager reviews, and organizing materials for calibration. Performance reviews launch Q1\.

**Operations \& Cross\-Functional Support**

* **Time tracking oversight:** Own time tracking data cleanup and submission — ensure hours are accurately logged, categorized, and submitted on schedule across teams.
* **ClickUp and project management:** Provide continuous oversight and support for ClickUp across the organization — maintaining workspace hygiene, supporting teams with task management, and ensuring processes are followed.
* **AI usage and cost oversight:** Monitor AI tool usage and associated costs across the company. Flag spend trends, support adoption, and ensure tools are being used efficiently.
* **All Hands on Deck (AHOD) preparation:** Own the AHOD deck coordination — ensure the deck is sent to the executive team a minimum of two weeks in advance for their slides. Own putting in and presenting Ops updates.
* **Contract management support:** Support Client Success and Sales with contract management — addendums, SOWs, renewals, and new agreements. Track status and flag anything stalled.
* **Process documentation:** Document recurring processes, workflows, and escalation paths. Reduce tribal knowledge by building systems and SOPs that outlast any single person.
* **Cross\-department coordination:** Serve as the operational connective tissue between Finance, People Ops, Client Success, and department leads. Triage incoming requests and route them to the right owner.
* **Ad hoc operational projects:** Take on special projects as assigned by the Director of Ops — everything from vendor research to data cleanup to rolling out new tools or policies.

 **AI Usage and Tooling**

* **Optimization:** Identify where AI can expand your capabilities and implement accordingly.
* **Tooling:** Build and utilize agents, skills, and other AI tools.
* **Research and Project Assistance:** Use constructive, robust prompts to generate top results and share best practices with the team.

**Who You Are**
===============

* **Operationally sharp:** You catch things that other people miss. A contractor invoice that wasn’t in the forecast, a subscription on the wrong card, a hiring request that’s missing a business case — you notice and you flag it.
* **Systems\-minded:** You think in workflows, not one\-off tasks. When you solve a problem, you build a process so it doesn’t happen again.
* **Comfortable across domains:** You’re not intimidated by switching between a payroll question, a billing discrepancy, and a policy draft in the same morning. Versatility is the job.
* **Proactive communicator:** You surface issues early, ask the right questions, and keep stakeholders informed without being asked. You know when to handle something yourself and when to escalate.
* **Detail\-oriented with good judgment:** You get the details right on compliance checks, invoice reviews, and employee records — but you also know when to zoom out and flag a bigger pattern.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You don’t need a perfectly scoped task list to be productive. You can take a broad mandate and figure out what needs to happen next.

**Qualifications**
==================

* 4\+ years of experience in business operations, office management, people operations, or a similar generalist role
* Experience working with payroll platforms (Gusto preferred), project management tools (ClickUp preferred), and financial tracking systems
* Strong spreadsheet skills and comfort working with financial data (cost trackers, forecasts, invoice reconciliation)
* Excellent written communication — you’ll be drafting SOPs, policies, and cross\-functional updates regularly
* Experience in a remote\-first environment with distributed teams

**Preferred**

* Experience at a marketing agency, professional services firm, or fast\-growing startup
* Familiarity with EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System), or similar systems
* Experience with Brex, PandaDoc, Slack workflows, or similar operational tooling
* Exposure to contractor management or multi\-state employment compliance

 **Compensation**

* **Salary:** $50k\-$90k USD/annually (based on location and skill set)
* **PTO:** Up to 18 days when 1099 and Flexible PTO when W2 (US\-based and long\-term)
* **Benefits (US W2 only):** Medical, Dental, and Vision reimbursement up to $500, 401k, and Aflac (Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, Mental Health, etc.)

title: Director of User Experience
description:
Our people are our greatest differentiator at Second Nature. To build an industry\-changing business, we don’t just need talent; we need an environment where high standards, continuous improvement, and customer obsession are the default.


Excellence is not a destination; it is how we show up every day. In twenty years time, we want every single employee to look back to their time at Second Nature and say: This is where I did my very best work. Where I grew the most. Where I pushed myself beyond what was comfortable.  



  

**About Us**
------------


Today, we live in a world where everything has become convenient. Now you can get a ride anywhere, buy anything, answer any question with just a couple clicks on your phone. Convenience isn't a luxury, it's an expectation.


So why not renting? It's still a chore to get utilities set up, buy renters insurance, get air filters changed, handle pest control, and more.


That's why we've built the world's first Resident Experience Platform that makes resident onboarding, resident services, and ancillary revenue effortless for property managers.


We're passionate about turning friction into triple win experiences for residents, property managers, and investors. That way renting can be easy and rewarding for everyone.


And now you can join us. Apply today to join 300\+ passionate, creative people who strive to make a difference each day so residents, property managers, and investors all win; creating the ultimate Triple Win.  



**About the role**
------------------


Second Nature helped define resident experience as a category in property management. 2,500\+ property management companies run on our platform, we've delivered over 2 million resident experiences, and we've been named NARPM Affiliate of the Year seven times. Holding that position depends on whether the experience is genuinely better at every touchpoint.  

  

Our experience surfaces touch Resident Onboarding, the Resident Benefits Package and the services inside it; Maestro, our experience orchestrator; and the internal tooling our operations teams run on. Every decision has to account for the property manager, resident and the people who support them.

  

AI is now part of how we build: product managers explore concepts, engineers can produce interfaces and content, and our design system lets either of them ship. We want a design leader who uses that speed and still defends a high bar of what great design, content and interaction looks like.

  

You will lead content and user experience, reporting to the VP of Product, managing a team of 4\-6 across product domains and strategic initiatives. We work in the "Product Trio" model, and your team embeds into the leadership structure of each team it works with, operating as a strategic counterpart to product and engineering leadership across multiple product areas rather than a single stream. You'll also partner directly with Customer Success, Implementation, and Data leaders, who depend on these experiences as much as our customers do.


This role is a strategic player\-coach position (roughly 80% leadership \& team development, 20% hands\-on strategic design direction). Your hands\-on contribution focuses on high\-level framing, experience architecture, and driving design sprints for ambiguous, high\-stakes new product surfaces.

**What you'll be responsible for**
----------------------------------

* **The Experience Vision.** A cohesive UX strategy and North Star for the Resident Experience Platform, aligned to company and product strategy.
* **Design Culture.** Critique that improves the work, cross\-functional collaboration, and knowledge sharing. You raise the UX bar across the whole company through coaching, workshops, and design share\-outs, not just inside your team.
* **The team's growth \& development.** Hiring, Growth plans, leveling, compensation conversations, and feedback delivered early enough to be useful.
* **A design portfolio of your own.** Named strategic projects, carried end to end.
* **The Design System.** Tokens, patterns, accessibility standards, governance, and an adoption number you report on.
* **The Research Practice.** Who we talk to to drive the most leverage, how often, and how evidence reaches a decision. Including what we learn that contradicts our thinking.
* **Content Design.** Supporting the practice alongside interaction and visual craft.
* **The AI UX/Content operating model.** Tooling, risk tiering, guardrails, and demonstrable examples that show whether it's meeting outcomes.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**Within 90 days.** Know each designer's strengths and blind spots, with growth plans established. Publish a design coverage map: where support is real, where it's thin, what you'd trade off. Finish a design system audit with a component inventory, adoption baseline per surface, and the biggest sources of drift ranked by cost.

**By six months.** Design system adoption up on net\-new UI across resident and property\-manager surfaces, with a refined contribution model engineers/pm use without needing to route everything through your team. A research cadence with residents and property managers that produces evidence teams cite in decisions. Published risk\-tiering criteria, with a measured split of async versus full review and a rework rate you watch. Your first strategic project delivered.

**By twelve months.** Measurable movement on resident onboarding completion, move\-in satisfaction, and support deflection, along with a fourth metric you and the domain product leads agree on. Lower time\-on\-task across our highest\-volume internal operations workflows. A shorter path from problem framing to testable prototype, with rework flat or down.

**About you**
-------------

* 8\+ years in digital product UX, with 3\+ years managing designers directly.
* **Current craft.** You still design, and you can show recent work you made yourself.
* **Evidence you grow people.** We'll ask you to name someone you leveled up, what you did, and where they are now.
* **Design systems at the architecture level.** How tokens and patterns compose, how contribution works when it's distributed, how you hold drift down without becoming a gate.
* The ability to look at a body of UX or content work and say what's strong, what's derivative, and what level it maps to.
* **Measurement.** You define the metric before the work starts, instrument it, and change course when it moves the wrong way.
* **Executive communication.** You can put UX strategy, tradeoffs, and outcomes in front of the exec team and explain what design decisions do to business metrics and the Triple Win.
* **Research leadership.** You can build a practice: a repeatable cadence of talking to residents and property managers, usability testing before launch, behavioral data used to decide.
* **A position on AI and design**, covering both the product surface and your team's own practice.
* **Hands\-on with AI tooling.** Prototyping, content, research synthesis, or design\-system compliance on real shipped work.
* You don't hold your biases too closely, and you know when to compromise.
* **Range across consumer and operator design.** Residents and property managers want different things, and a leader fluent in one register risks underserving the other.

 *We get it. Requirements can sometimes hold people back from applying to a job, but don't let that be the case here. If you believe you have the skills it takes to elevate this role, team, and company, we encourage you to apply for this role.*

**Remote Work Statement**
-------------------------


This position is a remote\-first, work from home position. Second Nature is committed to creating a culture and workplace where remote work fosters collaboration and connections and is a key part of our company story and success. To be successful in a remote work role at Second Nature you must:

* Be available during your scheduled working hours and give your full attention to the completion of your Second Nature job duties
* Have a quiet, professional, distraction\-free environment in which to complete your work
* Have access to your own reliable high\-speed internet connection
* Attend our bi\-annual in\-person company meetings (Second Nature will reimburse the cost of your business travel per company guidelines)

**Our Core Values**


Pirate Ship; not a cruise ship. Bias towards action.  

Massive Growth takes massive growth. We embrace challenges to increase our impact.  

Grow the Pie. We focus on results so our customers \& their customers win. Triple Win!  

Purple Heart. We put the team before ourselves.  

Extreme Ownership. See something? Say something; right the ship to get us back on course.  

Be a moment maker. We aim to shatter the status quo.

**Why Second Nature?**
----------------------

* Health First: Medical, Dental, Vision, \& Life Insurance; 401K Plan
* Location: Work Remotely from anywhere in the US
* Flexibility: Open PTO and sick days
* Culture: Diverse, inclusive, supportive, and growth\-focused
* Growth: Be part of a fast\-growing team building a new category and making a real difference
* The Product: Award\-winning, customer\-loved platform that truly delivers on our mission

 *Second Nature is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We take action to ensure equal employment opportunities for all candidates and employees and to provide employees with a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. Our hiring decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by federal and/or state law.*

 Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Argentina, this role is fully remote—giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Strategy. Act as the main leadership point of contact with responsibility for overall user and revenue growth in Argentina. You'll bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, product, content and finance to create and execute a cohesive multi\-year growth strategy, and own the KPIs including MAUs and ARR.
* Localisation. Work closely with the regional team to optimise our product, content, pricing and packaging to meet the needs of local users, informed by a deep understanding of local market dynamics and cultural nuances across a range of audiences, including knowledge workers, SMBs, students, startup ecosystems, NGOs, and other emerging sectors.

* You possess experience growing a market. For example, as the regional GM or brand lead for a global SaaS company, or as a proven founder or growth lead in a startup in a high growth environment.
* You are a proven leader. Ability to grow, inspire, and coach high\-performing teams. You have high emotional intelligence and empathy, and are a deeply collaborative teammate.

* You are keenly analytical. Deeply focused on KPIs and obsessive about driving actionable insights from disparate datasets and able to think about a market’s performance holistically.
* you are product oriented. Passion for improving the experience of users and the ability to translate local insights into product requirements with experience localising a global product for a particular market.
* You are values aligned. Genuinely excited by Canva’s mission and deeply aligned with our values, and with exceptional references to prove it.

Our team partners with functions across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, Partnerships, Content, Finance, and Strategy to drive sustainable user and revenue growth in international markets.
   

  

 As the Country Manager for Argentina, you will be the main point of contact and the driving force behind Canva’s success in the country. You will own and implement a multi\-year strategic roadmap, leading cross\-functional efforts to grow the user base and scale revenue.

 Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

* Inclusive parental leave policy
* An annual Vibe \& Thrive package to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup \& more

 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

Our multidisciplinary team brings together interior designers, brand designers, strategists, advisors, chefs, and hospitality operators. **Design Expertise**

* Lead projects and the creative process from concept to delivery; with proven track record of strong design narrative where storytelling remains at the heart of the project throughout its development
* Lead and contribute hands\-on to concept development and design presentations, test fits, spatial planning, and 3D models, with a strong focus on guest experience and operational functionality
* Review detailed drawing packages, finishes and FF\&E specifications ensuring technical requirements and design intent are successfully co\-ordinated, including liaising effectively with clients, consultants, contractors and suppliers throughout the design and delivery process
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of design detailing, materials, finishes, fixtures and furniture, including fabrication and construction processes

* Maintain oversight and remain actively involved and hands\-on throughout the entire project process, from initial concept through to design development, documentation, and delivery

* Manage projects effectively against agreed programmes, budgets, contractual scope of services, and commercial requirements
* Identify project risks and challenges early and work proactively with leadership team to resolve them
* Provide clear and timely reporting to the leadership team on project progress, resourcing, and key issues

 **Team Development \& Management**

* Lead, mentor and train junior team members to support their professional and creative development, and maximise team performance and quality design output

* Adobe Suite
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* PowerPoint
* Microsoft Office


Experience with the following would be advantageous:

* Miro
* Asana

  

The role is based in our Covent Garden studio in London, with a hybrid working model of three days per week in the studio, and two days working remotely from home.

 **Requirements** **What we are looking for:**


We are looking for an accomplished hospitality designer and creative leader who combines exceptional design ability with strong project, team, and client leadership.


The successful candidate will have:

* 10\+ years' professional experience in interior design or interior architecture, with significant experience in hospitality and F\&B environments
* An outstanding portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative quality across restaurants, food halls, bars, and other hospitality and commercial environments having worked through Riba stages 1\-6
* A proven ability to develop emotive, narrative\-driven, and design\-led concepts and experiences, across projects of varying scales and geographies
* Strong creative leadership, with the ability to take projects from initial concept and storytelling through design development and delivery, including technical and construction expertise

* Commercial awareness and an understanding of project programmes, budgets/value engineering, contracts, fees, and resourcing
* Excellent client\-facing, presentation, and communication skills
* A collaborative, adaptable, no\-ego approach, and a commitment to contributing positively to studio culture

title: Account Director - GCC
description:
#### **About Us**


For over two decades, The Boundary has been at the forefront of digital excellence. With a global team of 150\+ experts across London, New York, Dubai, and Auckland, we partner with the world's leading developers to deliver unparalleled architectural storytelling.


Founded by award\-winning architects, our work sits at the intersection of design intuition and technical mastery. From pioneering digital twin infrastructure to the seamless integration of AI and real\-time technology, we don’t just anticipate the future of the industry; we are already building it.

#### **The Opportunity**


The strongest client relationships do more than sustain great work. They create the trust, clarity and commercial confidence that allow ambitious ideas to move forward.


At The Boundary, we partner with leading developers, architects, real estate businesses and global brands to bring places and ideas to life. Our Account Directors sit at the centre of those partnerships \- understanding what matters to the client, aligning the right internal teams and ensuring that every interaction strengthens the relationship.


We are looking for an experienced Account Director to lead a portfolio of high\-value accounts across the GCC region. This is a senior client leadership role with clear accountability for relationship health, retention, account growth and service excellence.

#### **What we're looking for**


You are a strategic account leader who combines excellent judgement with strong commercial instincts. You understand how to build trusted, long\-term relationships while identifying the opportunities that create genuine value for both the client and the business.


You are comfortable working across complex, multi\-service accounts and high\-profile projects. You can move confidently between long\-range account planning, commercial discussions, delivery oversight and urgent issue resolution without losing sight of the wider relationship.


Clients trust you because you listen carefully, communicate clearly and follow through. Internal teams trust you because you translate client priorities into focused, achievable plans and advocate for the relationship without compromising delivery quality, capacity or process.


You are also an experienced people leader. You know how to mentor client\-service professionals, give useful feedback and raise standards while creating the confidence and clarity people need to perform at their best.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Lead strategic client relationships.** Act as the senior strategic lead and primary point of contact for a portfolio of key accounts, developing a detailed understanding of each client's objectives, stakeholders, priorities and long\-term opportunities.

**Build account plans that deliver growth.** Own relationship planning, support client tiering and identify well\-timed opportunities to retain, expand, cross\-sell and upsell services within existing accounts.

**Shape commercial opportunities.** Partner with Business Development and regional leadership on proposals, pitches and commercial discussions, ensuring opportunities are well scoped and aligned with client needs and business priorities.

**Provide delivery governance.** Work with Project Management, Production and Creative leaders to ensure briefs are translated into clear, achievable plans, risks are identified early and strategic deliverables remain aligned with expectations.

**Resolve issues with pace and judgement.** Take ownership of client concerns and escalations, establish clear resolution plans and maintain trust through professional, transparent communication.

**Create continuity from pitch to delivery.** Support the onboarding of high\-value projects and ensure the Client Services function is properly represented in project timelines, resourcing and creative\-development conversations.

**Develop the Client Services team.** Mentor Senior Managers and Managers across multiple accounts, contribute to onboarding and training, and provide clear feedback that strengthens commercial awareness and service quality.

**Improve how we work.** Champion consistent use of systems, SOPs and shared templates; identify process gaps; and lead post\-mortems or service audits that turn project experience into practical improvement.

**Maintain accurate account intelligence.** Track account health, engagement, feedback, opportunities and risks, ensuring information is complete, current and visible to the relevant leadership teams.

#### **What You'll Bring**

**Substantial senior client\-services experience.** Typically eight or more years in strategic account management or a comparable client leadership role, with responsibility for significant, complex accounts.

**A proven record of account growth.** Evidence of retaining and expanding key relationships, identifying commercially sound opportunities and contributing to successful proposals or pitches.

**Experience in a relevant environment.** A background in a creative, advertising, architectural, real estate, SaaS or related professional\-services business. Agency or creative\-production experience would be particularly valuable.

**Strong commercial acumen.** Confidence discussing scope, budgets, value and delivery trade\-offs, with the judgement to balance client priorities against operational and commercial realities.

**Executive\-level communication.** Excellent presentation, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to lead high\-stakes conversations and build credibility with senior decision\-makers.

**Delivery understanding.** A practical knowledge of project\-delivery workflows and the ability to work effectively with Project Management, Production, Creative and Finance teams.

**People leadership.** Experience mentoring colleagues, providing performance feedback and improving capability across a client\-services team.

**A proactive, solutions\-focused approach.** You are tenacious, organised and accountable, absorb new technical and industry knowledge quickly, and respond constructively to feedback.

**Relevant education or equivalent experience.** A bachelor's degree in Management, Marketing, Real Estate or a related field is preferred, but substantial relevant experience is equally important.

 We're looking for an entrepreneurial marketing leader who wants to continue building a strong brand, not simply manage and execute.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




  





 As our Marketing \& Growth Manager, you will own the execution of Rite's marketing strategy across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
 



 You will be responsible for ensuring every customer touchpoint \- from paid advertising and social media to CRM, influencers, and content \- works together to build a premium brand while driving profitable growth.
 



 Rather than executing every task yourself, your role is to lead internal and external partners, challenge ideas, improve creative quality, and make sure every initiative contributes to business growth.
 



 You'll work closely with the founders and become one of the key leaders shaping Rite's future.
 



  





**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Brand \& Creative Leadership** 



* Own Rite's brand positioning across all channels.
* Define the creative direction for advertising and organic content, both online and offline.
* Ensure consistency across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, CRM, and the website.
* Challenge and improve every creative before production.
* Build a premium, recognizable wellness brand online and offline.



  





**Performance Marketing** 




 Work closely with our Media Buyer, UGC ads agency, and Creative Strategist by:
 


* Reviewing weekly performance.
* Identifying winning creative angles for the UAE and KSA markets.
* Defining testing priorities with our Creative Strategist and adapting them culturally to both countries.
* Ensuring creative production aligns with performance insights.
* Coordinating creative strategy with media buying.



  





**Content \& Social Media** 




 Own:
 


* Content calendar.
* Social strategy.
* Organic growth.
* Video production for product launches or specific campaigns.
* UGC planning.
* Community building.
* Brand storytelling.



 Coordinate with external UGC agencies and freelance creators.
 



 Manage our in\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive, who will support you with execution.
 



  





**Influencer Strategy** 




 Lead the entire influencer programme strategy by managing our Influencer \& Partnerships Manager and external agencies responsible for execution.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Supporting creator sourcing.
* Supporting negotiations.
* Leading the affiliate strategy and ecosystem.
* Leading the whitelisting strategy.
* Campaign execution.
* Performance reporting.



 Build long\-term relationships with creators across the UAE and Saudi Arabia and ensure that deliverables are properly executed by your team and external agencies.
 



  





**Partnerships \& Brand Activations** 




 Lead Rite's partnership strategy to increase brand awareness, customer acquisition, and community engagement.
 


* Develop co\-marketing campaigns and brand collaborations.
* Support our Brand Partnerships \& Sales Manager with brand activations, pop\-ups, sampling campaigns, and wellness events.
* Support the creation of packaging, PR boxes, and marketing collateral.
* Manage sponsorship opportunities and experiential marketing initiatives.
* Create partnerships that generate both commercial opportunities and long\-term brand equity.



  





**CRM \& Customer Retention** 




 Be the main point of contact for our CRM agency and support them with strategy and execution.
 



 Own:
 


* Email strategy.
* Customer journeys.
* Campaign calendar.
* Loyalty initiatives.
* Product launches.



  





**Agency Management** 




 Coordinate multiple external partners, including:
 


* Creative agencies.
* UGC agencies and UGC creators.
* Production companies.
* Influencer agencies.
* CRM agency.
* Freelancers, including video editors and graphic designers.



 Ensure everyone works toward the same objectives.
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 Manage and work closely with:
 


* Creative Strategist, remote.
* In\-house Graphic Designer.
* In\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive.
* Country Manager Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh.



 Create a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, speed, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**We're Looking for Someone Who...** 



* Has 3–5\+ years of experience in e\-commerce, DTC, or consumer brands.
* Has extensive experience in performance marketing, offline marketing, content, social media, and influencer management.
* Understands how strong marketing drives acquisition.
* Has managed multiple agencies and cross\-functional teams.
* Has deep knowledge of UAE and Saudi consumer behaviour.
* Understands influencer marketing beyond vanity metrics.
* Thinks commercially, not just creatively.
* Is highly organised and execution\-focused.
* Is proactive, curious, and constantly looking for better ways of doing things.
* Has strong skills in the use of AI to set up efficient systems and SOPs.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**The Entrepreneurial Mindset We're Looking For** 




 We're not looking for someone who waits for instructions.
 



 We want someone who:
 


* Treats Rite as if it were their own company.
* Challenges existing ideas and proposes better ones.
* Takes ownership rather than simply completing tasks.
* Is obsessed with customer experience and business growth.
* Moves fast, learns quickly, and embraces experimentation.
* Is comfortable wearing multiple hats.
* Makes decisions using both data and intuition.
* Inspires the team through energy, curiosity, and ambition.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A unique opportunity to build one of the fastest\-growing wellness brands in the Middle East from the inside.
* High ownership and autonomy, with the ability to shape our brand, growth strategy, and partnership ecosystem alongside the founders.
* A competitive salary complemented by a performance\-based bonus.
* The chance to recruit, lead, and develop a high\-performing marketing team as the company scales.
* Exposure to multiple high\-growth markets, with a strong focus on the UAE and Saudi Arabia and future international expansion.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution without unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Company visa, comprehensive health insurance, annual flight ticket, generous annual leave, and the tools you need to perform at your best.
* Flexible working arrangements and the opportunity to travel to Saudi Arabia for key partnerships, product launches, retail activations, and industry events.
* Unlimited access to Rite products and the opportunity to help shape the future of wellness in the region.

title: Director, Events & Experiential Marketing
description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

  

  

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

  

  

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

  

  

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.  



  

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.  



  

We are seeking a **Director of Events \& Experiential Marketing** to spearhead our events and efforts in bringing our brand, benefits, products and experiences directly in\-person with prospects and customers. This role will lead our event planning and execution efforts, with a primary focus on promoting and enhancing the PSA brand presence. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in event management, exceptional organizational skills, a passion for collectibles and the hobby, and experience in managing large flagship events along with a diverse portfolio of smaller events at scale. Building a robust international events and experiential roadmap is also a key component of this role.

  

  

This role owns our events strategy as an organization inclusive of our event objectives, operations, production, activations, and experiential marketing. The Director serves as the central connector across Product, Operations, Customer Experience, Growth, and Brand to ensure clarity of strategy and disciplined execution. This leader brings deep, first\-hand credibility in events (trade events preferred) and plays a critical role in strengthening PSA's position at the center of the collector ecosystem.


You’ll report to the **Sr. Director, Marketing Operations and Planning** and work from our Santa Ana, CA or Jersey City, NJ office. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in\-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.


**What You’ll Do:**

* **Event Strategy \& Vision:** Own and evolve Collectors' and PSA's overarching events strategy, setting the multi\-year vision for how in\-person experiences build brand equity and drive commercial outcomes. Architect a portfolio spanning marquee flagship events, a scaled long tail of regional and local activations, and drop\-off events — ensuring each tier reinforces PSA's position at the center of the collector ecosystem.
* **Cultural Relevance \& Experiential Activations:** Identify and capitalize on key cultural moments — major sports and pop culture milestones, entertainment releases, industry conventions, and collector community moments — to position PSA at the forefront of culture. Design bold, memorable experiential activations that translate brand strategy into physical, shareable experiences, elevating PSA's presence beyond traditional trade events and into the broader cultural conversation.
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Partnership:** Serve as the central connector across Product, Operations, Customer Experience, Growth, and Brand, ensuring strategic alignment and disciplined execution. Cultivate high\-value partnerships with strategic partners, industry organizations, and co\-branded event opportunities that maximize exposure and deepen industry relationships worldwide.
* **Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement:** Act as the primary voice for events strategy with senior leadership, external partners, vendors, and collector communities, translating event performance into business impact for executive stakeholders. Must have experience and strength with internal stakeholder management.
* **End\-to\-End Event Operations:** Direct end\-to\-end planning and execution across the full event portfolio — budgeting, logistics, venue strategy, vendor management, activation execution, and timeline governance — with accountability for operational excellence at scale.
* **Marketing Integration:** Partner with Marketing leadership to ensure event strategy is fully integrated into broader marketing plans, orchestrating pre\-event, on\-site, and post\-event efforts that amplify reach across international markets and channels.
* **Team Building \& Development:** Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing events organization — hiring, mentoring, and scaling the team's capabilities to match the growing ambition of the events roadmap. Foster a culture of creativity, ownership, and operational rigor.
* **Revenue \& Sponsorship Strategy:** Develop and lead a sponsorship strategy that identifies, secures, and grows sponsorships, partnerships, and exhibitor relationships — treating events as a revenue\-generating channel, not just a brand cost center.
* **International Expansion \& Global Roadmap:** Build and own a robust international events and experiential roadmap, expanding the Collectors and PSA brand footprint across global markets. Adapt strategy to regional nuances while maintaining a cohesive global brand experience.
* **Metrics, Reporting \& ROI:** Define and own KPIs across the event portfolio, delivering executive\-level reporting on ROI, brand impact, and attendee sentiment to inform ongoing investment decisions.
* **Innovation \& Industry Foresight:** Champion emerging event technologies and experiential trends, ensuring Collectors and PSA remain innovators — not followers — in how the hobby experiences live brand moments.

**Who You Are :**

* 7\+ years in event management, including significant exposure to trade shows, conventions, experiential activations, and large\-scale events.
* Experience with multi\-format events and end\-to\-end ownership.
* Strong leadership, team management and internal stakeholder alignment skills.
* Ability to manage and work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders.
* Exceptional organizational and project management capabilities.
* Ability to use data to inform investment and strategy.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; master’s degree preferred
* A passion for collectibles and an understanding of the PSA and PCGS authentication and grading process is a plus.

**Salary Range:**

The salary range for this position is **$163,308 – $267,038** . Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set.


**Reasons To Join Us:**

* **Health Insurance:** All full\-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision
* **Additional Benefits:** Full\-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits
* **401(K) Matching Plan:** We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals
* **Vacation:** All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time\-off
* **Holiday Pay:** All regular, full\-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays
* **Employee Discounts:** Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions
* **Flexible Hours:** Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs
* **Fun Working Environment:** Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities

  

Collectors uses e\-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States.  



  

We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e\-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business\-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to interviewfraud@collectors.com.  



  

*We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.*

  

*If you require an accommodation to apply or interview with us due to a disability or special need, please email* *interviewaccommodation@collectors.com*

  

*U.S. residents: for disclosures relating to personal information we collect during the employment application and recruitment process, please see our* *Privacy Notice for U.S. Applicants* *.*

title: Roark Global Marketing Director
description:
**Who We Are**
 Roark is a premium Adventure Lifestyle brand. Working within the Outdoor, Surf, and Lifestyle channels and offering product that performs without jeopardizing style. Always inspired by the journey. Roark has a collaborative and fast\-paced environment where operational excellence directly supports brand growth and customer success.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Global Marketing Director leads the Roark marketing function across every channel and every market. You set the brand vision and you run the process that delivers it. This role requires both: a clear point of view on where the brand is going in the adventure\-lifestyle space and the operational command to get it there season after season.
   

  

 You own marketing's seat in the 18\-month GTM process, working alongside product, merchandising, planning and sales leaders. Every brand asset the company produces flows through your team and carries your approval: campaign, ECOM, owned retail, wholesale, media, social, PR and athlete. You are accountable for the quality of the work, the timing of the work, and the budget behind it.
   

  

 You lead a team of four: Marketing Manager, Art Director, a contract Community Manager, and an Athlete Manager. You report to the Founder and Chief Brand Officer, and you carry the brand strategy into the rooms where the commercial plan is set.
   

  

 We are looking for someone experience in brand marketing who has run a team, held an organization to a GTM calendar, directed campaign production, and can speak with equal command about DTC and Wholesale distribution. The seat rewards vision matched by command of the operating detail: a brand steward who holds a high creative bar, values the GTM process, develops the people who report to them, and has the credibility to lead peers who do not. Deep working knowledge of and credibility within the adventure travel, surf, run, climb and trail communities is essential to this role.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**
 Brand Vision and Strategy
   

  

* Own the Roark brand strategy: positioning, seasonal narrative, franchise focus, category priorities, and the consumer targets behind them. Translate strategy into a marketing plan the team and the business can execute.
* Set the annual and seasonal marketing plan against the commercial plan. Know the number each channel carries and build marketing behind it.
* Own the brand book and brand guidelines. Approve how Roark is expressed in every market, by every internal team, and by every external partner.
* Bring consumer, category and competitive insight into product and merchandising conversations early enough to influence the line.
* Evaluate opportunities against long term brand equity while managing near term revenue. gains


 GTM Leadership
   

  

* Own marketing's seat in the 18\-month GTM process. Represent marketing at every gate from line planning and adoption through sell in and consumer launch.
* Set and hold the seasonal GTM calendar. Approve the critical path, arbitrate conflicts between channels, and make the call when a date moves.
* Write and approve the seasonal go to market brief that creative, copy, ECOM, retail and sales all execute from.
* Lead seasonal kickoff and launch readiness reviews with product, merchandising, planning, sales, ECOM and retail leadership.
* Hold the organization accountable to the process. The GTM calendar is the operating document for the brand, not a marketing artifact.


 Brand Asset Creation and Omni Channel Distribution
   

  

* Own the creation of all Roark brand assets: seasonal campaign photography and film, product imagery, catalogs, look books, line sheets, account presentations, in store and window graphics, trade show and event materials.
* Manage the Art Director on creative output. Set the brief, review the work, approve the final. You are the last brand approval on everything that ships.
* Own asset distribution against the GTM calendar globally: media and press, social, PR, influencer and athlete, ECOM and site, email and SMS, paid, owned retail, wholesale partner portals, and drop ship partners.
* Own media relationships and the PR program. Set the earned media strategy and the seasonal press calendar, and approve the assets and messaging that go out.
* Own asset governance: naming conventions, rights and usage, versioning, and a single approved DAM library that every channel and partner pulls from.


 DTC Distribution
   

  

* Partner with ECOM leadership on the site and digital marketing plan: launch calendar, merchandising stories, email and SMS, paid media, and content built to convert.
* Own the brand layer of DTC. How the campaign shows up on site, in email, in social and in paid, and whether it reads as one brand.
* Own the owned retail marketing program: seasonal windows, retail pathway visuals and in store storytelling, floor set support, store communication, openings and local activation.
* Review DTC performance monthly with ECOM and retail, and carry what you learn into the next seasonal plan.


 Wholesale Distribution
   

  

* Own the seasonal sell in Playbook: line sheets, brand and category presentations, seasonal story decks, digital assets for account portals, showroom and sample support.
* Direct account facing marketing across Core specialty, wholesale accounts, drop ship, and International distribution: co\-op programs, shop in shops, POP and fixture programs, catalog placements, and partner asset submissions.
* Build marketing support around the prebook and at once rhythm, delivered ahead of every prebook window.
* Partner with sales leadership to connect marketing investment to sell in and sell thru, and place co\-op dollars where they move product.
* Govern how the brand is represented in partner channels, on partner sites, and in partner marketing.


 Team Leadership and Collaboration
   

  

* Lead, coach and develop the team: Marketing Manager, Art Director, contract Community Manager, and Athlete Manager. Set goals, run reviews, build growth paths.
* Direct the Community Manager on grassroots, event and community programming, and the Athlete Manager on the athlete and ambassador roster, contracts, seeding and content capture.
* Run the marketing operating rhythm and make sure decisions get made, documented and communicated the same week they are needed.
* Communicate up and across. Present the plan, the calendar and the results to the Founder and Chief Brand Officer and to department leaders in a form they can act on.
* Manage the marketing budget: build it, allocate it across brand, channel and market, defend it, and reconcile it monthly.
* Manage agency, vendor and freelance partners: scope, bid, contract and performance.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or related discipline or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 8 years in brand marketing at a consumer brand in apparel, Outdoor, Surf or premium lifestyle, with real time at both the strategic and the executional level.
* Proven people leadership. You have built and led a marketing team, including creative talent, and you have managed contract and agency resources.
* Demonstrated ownership of a GTM process at brand scale. You have set a seasonal calendar and held an organization to it.
* Global Brand strategy experience: positioning, narrative, guidelines, and the discipline to keep a brand consistent across channels and markets.
* Creative and content production leadership. You have directed campaign photo and film production and taken brand assets through to delivery across every channel.
* Media, social and PR fluency: earned media strategy, press relationships, social and influencer programs, and athlete or ambassador programs.
* Command of both sides of distribution. DTC (ECOM and owned retail) and Wholesale (prebook and at once, sell in versus sell thru, Core specialty, Majors, co\-op, retailer asset requirements).
* Budget ownership at the department level: build, allocate, defend, reconcile.
* Excellent communication. You present clearly to a founder, CEO, brief clearly to a designer, and align peers who do not report to you.
* Proficiency with project management and creative operations tooling (Asana), B2B (Elastic), and DAM systems, Adobe Creative Suite files, and ECOM Shopify platforms.
* A high level of passion in the Outdoor lifestyle. You live in the world Roark builds product for: Adventure travel, surf, running, climbing, trail, and the culture around it.
* Actively seeks out AI\-enabled tools and emerging technologies, adapting quickly to leverage them for improved productivity, deeper insights, and more effective processes, while exercising sound judgment and maintaining compliance with organizational standards


**Preferred Qualifications**
* International, UK and EU, AUS market experience, and experience supporting international distribution partners.
* Experience at a brand with both a healthy DTC and wholesale business, and a process to balance them efficiently.
* Experience building or rebuilding a GTM process from a low base.
* Trade show and sales meeting production leadership.
* Experience managing an athlete or ambassador roster.


 How Success is Measured
   

  

 First 90 Days
   

  

* Current Brand strategy and the seasonal marketing plan understood and articulated, aligned with the Founder and Chief Brand Officer, CEO and understood by key department leaders.
* Marketing's role in the 18\-month GTM process documented, with clear gates, owners and deliverables.
* Team assessed, goals set, and any capability or capacity gaps identified with a plan to close them.
* Asset and channel audit complete, with gaps for the next two seasonal deliveries identified.


 First Year
   

  

* Seasonal campaigns delivered on time and on brand across every channel and market, measured against the published critical path.
* Sell in Playbook released ahead of every prebook window, with adoption from the sales team and accounts.
* Measurable growth in earned media, social and community engagement against a defined baseline.
* ECOM and owned retail receive campaign packages on a predictable schedule, 1\-3 months before every launch.
* Global marketing budget managed to plan, with clean monthly reconciliation.
* Team retention, and demonstrable growth in all four direct reports.
* Evolved Marketing strategy for H2 2028 and beyond articulated for GTM planning process.


 Location \& Office Structure: This is an in\-office hybrid position, mandatory 4 days per week in office in Irvine, CA with the option to work from home 1 day per week. Subject to change without notice as per company guidelines.
   

  

 Compensation: The salary range for this position is $150,000 to $180,000 plus opportunity for annual bonus; salary is based on the experience that you bring to the position.
   

  

**Benefits And Perks**
* Complimentary chef prepared breakfast and lunch provided Monday \- Thursday
* Generous product gift program and all brand discounts
* Company bonus program
* 5 year and 10 year Milestone Anniversary travel gifts
* Medical, Dental, Vision insurance in accordance with plan guidelines
* Company paid life insurance in accordance with plan guidelines
* 401k with employer match in accordance with plan guidelines
* 15 Days of PTO accrued annually, plus one additional day of PTO every year on your anniversary, and 3 Floating Holidays per year
* Paid beach and giveback days, bi\-annual team building events and other in\-person celebrations
* Work with talented and great people who share a love of Roark
* Dog friendly office

title: Strategy Director
description:
Who We Are
 

 We are an award\-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally\-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 
 



 We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 
 



 We are looking for a 
 **Strategy Director** 
 to join Translation! Please note that this role demands four days in office and one day remote. 
 


 What You'll Do
 * Ensure the quality, clarity, and accuracy of audience, cultural, and brand insights
* Identify the "real” problem of every business and brand challenge, quickly assessing and defining  the “why” and “how” of every brief
* Expertly guide brand positioning and inform messaging and channel strategy
* Lead day\-to\-day client and project engagements across key accounts
* Work closely with data strategists, context planners, account directors, and creatives to formulate and execute a vision for how we respond to every brand assignment
* Build positive relationships internally and externally, inspiring work from common intent and shared desired outcomes
* Oversee the output of  junior team members to ensure it meets client goals and business objectives
* Contribute to the intellectual capital of the company as it relates to the understanding and decoding of audience and cultural insights



**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** 

* Clear and persuasive communication skills with a knack for storytelling
