title: E-Commerce Director (Consumer Division)
description:
The E\-Commerce Director will lead digital commerce across its consumer brand portfolio (6 brands within a single product category family). This position owns the overall ecommerce strategy and P\&L performance across each brand's Shopify direct\-to\-consumer store, Amazon (FBA and FBM), and all secondary sales channels, including Walmart.com, eBay, Etsy, Google Shopping, Facebook/Instagram Shop, YouTube, and other emerging marketplaces.


This is a strategic leadership role, not a hands\-on execution role. The Ecommerce Director will not, on a daily basis, personally execute campaigns, design creative, or manage listings, but must bring deep, current expertise across paid advertising, content creation, digital marketing, email/SMS campaigns, affiliate marketing, SEO/GEO, and web design/UX in order to set direction, evaluate performance, coach staff, and hold the team accountable to results.


The Ecommerce Director will partner closely with the Brand Managers to build, drive, and execute strategies that accelerate profitable growth, and will direct the shared services team to bring those strategies to life.

**Essential Job Functions:**


Strategic Leadership \& Team Management \-

* Set the overall ecommerce vision, strategy, and annual growth plan for all six consumer brands across Shopify, Amazon, and secondary channels.
* Directly manage, coach, and develop 3 Brand Managers, setting clear goals, KPIs, and accountability standards for each brand under their purview.
* Directly manage the shared services team – Web Developer, Ecommerce Ad Manager, Amazon Ad Manager, and SEO/GEO Specialist – functioning as an internal agency that services all brands; set priorities, resolve resourcing conflicts, and ensure work is allocated effectively across brands based on strategic priority.
* Co\-create and drive c
* hannel and brand\-level strategies in close partnership with Brand Managers, translating division\-wide priorities into brand\-specific execution plans that the shared services team then executes against.
* Establish intake, prioritization, and workflow processes so Brand Managers can effectively request and receive support from the shared web, ad, and SEO/GEO functions without bottlenecks or conflicting priorities.
* Build a high\-performing ecommerce organization across both the Brand Manager and shared services layers; identify skill gaps and advocate for additional resources, agencies, or tools as needed.
* Own the ecommerce budget and revenue targets across the division; report performance, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Foster cross\-brand collaboration to share best practices, creative learnings, and efficiencies across all six consumer brands in the portfolio.


Markeplace \& Channel Strategy –

* Oversee strategy and performance across each brand's Shopify storefront, ensuring strong conversion rates, site health, and customer experience, directing the Web Developer's priorities accordingly.
* Direct Amazon strategy across both FBA and FBM models – including account health, inventory strategy, Buy Box performance, and marketplace compliance – in partnership with the Amazon Ad Manager and Brand Managers.
* Guide expansion and optimization of secondary channels including Walmart.com, eBay, Etsy, Google Shopping/Merchant Center, Facebook/Instagram Shop, YouTube Shopping, and other relevant marketplaces.
* Evaluate and prioritize new sales channel opportunities based on ROI, brand fit, and resourcing.


Paid Media \& Ad Spend –

* Set overarching paid media strategy and budget allocation across Amazon Ads, Google Ads/Shopping, Meta Ads, and YouTube, directing the Ecommerce Ad Manager and Amazon Ad Manager on efficient allocation of spend across all brands.
* Establish and monitor KPIs such as ROAS, TACoS/ACoS, CAC, and LTV; hold the ad management team and Brand Managers accountable to targets.
* Evaluate agency and platform partners that supplement the internal ad management team; approve major shifts in ad strategy or budget.


Content, Digital Marketing \& Email/Affiliate Programs –

* Direct content strategy (product photography, video, A\+ Content/Enhanced Brand Content, lifestyle content) ensuring brand consistency and conversion\-focused execution across all six brands.
* Guide digital marketing strategy including email/SMS lifecycle campaigns, promotional calendars, and customer retention programs.
* Oversee development and growth of affiliate and influencer marketing programs across brands.
* Direct the SEO/GEO Specialist's strategy and roadmap to maximize organic visibility across traditional search and AI\-driven search/answer engines, ensuring consistent execution across all brand sites.


Web Design \& User Experience

* Direct the Web Developer's priorities and roadmap across all Shopify storefronts, balancing competing requests from the various Brand Managers.
* Ensure a consistent, high\-quality, mobile\-optimized customer experience and strong CRO discipline across all brand sites and marketplace storefronts.


Analytics \& Reporting

* Establish division\-wide reporting standards and dashboards for sales, ad spend, marketplace, and channel performance, pulling from the Brand Managers and shared services specialists.
* Analyze performance trends across brands and channels to identify growth opportunities, risks, and areas needing intervention.
* Present regular performance updates and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

**Physical Demands:**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Must be able to sit at a desk for prolonged periods of time and work on a computer.
* Must be able to work in an office environment.
* Must be able to talk, hear and see with vision abilities including close/near, distance, color and peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
* Must wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when entering manufacturing areas.

**Education and Experience:**


Required –

* 7\+ years of progressive ecommerce experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role managing a team, a multi\-brand or multi\-channel portfolio, and/or a shared\-services/agency\-style function.
* Proven, demonstrable expertise across Shopify, Amazon Seller Central/Vendor Central (both FBA and FBM), and secondary marketplaces (Walmart.com, eBay, Etsy).
* Strong working knowledge of paid advertising across Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and YouTube, including budget strategy and performance evaluation, sufficient to direct and evaluate specialist ad managers.
* Deep familiarity with digital marketing disciplines: content strategy, email/SMS marketing, affiliate/influencer marketing, SEO, and emerging GEO/AI\-search optimization practices.
* Working knowledge of web design, UX principles, and conversion rate optimization best practices, sufficient to direct a web developer and evaluate their output.
* Experience managing a shared\-services or “internal agency” model, balancing and prioritizing competing requests from multiple internal stakeholders.
* Track record of setting strategy and managing performance through others rather than personally executing tactical work.
* Strong analytical skills; fluency with ecommerce analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Shopify Analytics, Amazon Brand Analytics, etc.) and ability to translate data into strategy.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred –

* Experience in building products, home improvement, industrial, or specialty/DIY consumer goods categories.
* Experience managing multiple distinct brands or business units simultaneously through a shared team structure.
* Familiarity with specialty coatings, resins, or adjacent DIY/trade product categories.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA a plus.

***What Success Looks Like:***

* Consistent, profitable revenue growth across all brands, channels, and marketplaces within the division.
* A well\-coached, accountable team of Brand Managers executing clear, data\-driven strategies, supported by a high\-functioning internal shared services team.
* Efficient, optimized ad spend delivering strong ROAS across all paid channels, with ad managers who are clear on priorities and accountable to results.
* Strong, consistent brand experiences and customer satisfaction across every website and marketplace storefront.
* A shared services model (web, ad, SEO/GEO) that runs smoothly, with clear prioritization and no brand feeling under\-served.
* Reliable, transparent reporting that gives executive leadership clear visibility into performance and growth opportunities.

***All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.***

description:

At **DICK'S Sporting Goods**, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.


If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world's greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

**OVERVIEW:**


As the Senior Director \- Corporate Systems, you are responsible for defining the enterprise systems vision for the Finance, HR, and Real Estate domains, as well as ensuring these platforms effectively support the broader needs of the organization. You are the "voice of the corporate systems," deeply understanding stakeholder requirements, regulatory obligations, operational workflows, and enterprise data needs to ensure they are incorporated into and prioritized within the roadmap, guided by business outcomes and measurable results.


You will lead the development of the corporate systems roadmap, setting direction and priorities across each functional domain. Additionally, you will be accountable for delivering the platforms, tools, and integrations that enable critical enterprise capabilities across Accounting \& Finance, People Operations, Payroll, Workforce Management, Real Estate, Store Development, and our Foundational Technology teams.


The role requires a strategic, operational, and execution‑focused leader who is highly motivated and accountable for delivering stable, scalable, and efficient systems that drive enterprise KPIs, including financial accuracy, operational efficiency, compliance, employee experience, and cost optimization. You will lead the Corporate Systems team and partner closely with Engineering, Executive Management, and Business stakeholders, bringing cohesion and coordination to enterprise initiatives by blending long‑term strategy with pragmatic problem‑solving.


You must operate at both levels: strategically identifying opportunities for modernization, automation, and simplification, while tactically resolving system gaps, process inefficiencies, and business challenges that arise in Finance, HR, and Real Estate operations.

**Role Responsibilities:**

**Strategy \& Planning**

* *Product Strategy \& Roadmap* \- You own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area of focus. Must be able to distill the "fire hose" of insights, data, and requests into an actionable vision inclusive of customer and business partners needs to build both incremental and innovative experiences for your customers, ensuring that value is delivered early, often, and in\-sync with customer goals. You are responsible for prioritizing features to support the enterprise cross\-functional roadmap across all product groups. This will also require saying up to date on industry trends and best practices in data and analytics and incorporating them into the strategy and execution.
* *Customer Value \& Business Outcomes* \- Ensures a business outcome is achieved and customers receive a product that provides value, whether it's an MVP or mature product with a new feature. Goes above and beyond defining and delivering. Requires a solid understanding of the inter\-relations of our business \- financial, marketing, sales, legal, partnerships, customer service, stores, technical capabilities, user experience.
* *Know Your Business* \- Accountable for results. Whether that is maximizing metrics, managing expectations, addressing customer feedback, or prioritizing the backlog. Knowing your numbers, competitors, who is doing what, the next big thing, suggesting innovative ideas to POC and constantly striving to increase revenue and conversion are primary responsibilities for your role. You will provide regular reporting to executive management along with strategies to constantly improve the numbers, hit revenue goals, and maximize return on investment.
* *Product Decisions* \- you will be called upon to make tough decisions, whether it is a go/no\-go decision, balancing risks versus reward, pros/cons, dependencies, cost/benefit analysis, or ROI of resource investment. You must stand behind your decision with facts and data. Must be able to recognize when to change course and reverse a decision, subscribing to the philosophy of learning fast, and moving on.
* *Budget Management* \- Manage a multimillion\-dollar capital and professional services budget; forecasting and creating business cases for additional funding, vendor selection and staff expansion.

**Delivery \& Execution**

* *Delivery \-* Lead the development and execution of the data and analytics roadmap, inclusive of strategic planning sessions and annual and quarterly planning sessions. In addition to overseeing the implementation and adherence to data governance and data lifecycle management processes.
* *Features \-* Manage and at times create accurate user stories and prioritizes the backlog; working with the team to groom, refine, and ultimately deliver the feature.
* *Partner \-* Be the critical partner across the organization, aligning with key Business stakeholders and roadmaps and KPIs, working with Engineering to ensure that data infrastructure and tools are in place to support data\-driven initiatives and linking with Program and Portfolio team to ensure on\-time, on\-budget delivery against prioritized initiatives.
* *Ceremonies \-* Participates in standups, planning sessions, demos, and retrospectives. Fosters team collaboration, co\-creation, and open communication.
* *Testing and Research \-* Formulates hypothesis to A/B test, prototype, or research, continually refining the product until desired outcome is achieved. Ensures successful tests are translated into new site features.
* *Vendors \-* Accountable for the management, selection, budget and oversight of a portfolio of 3rd party vendor partners. Regularly holding business reviews, monitoring SLAs, managing RFPs, negotiating contracts and managing budgets for those services.

**People**

* *Change Influencer \-* Acts as an agent of change within your team, organization, and leading to embrace new methodologies, processes, efficiencies and challenging the status quo. Constantly pushing and asking why even if it's to Senior Executives. You must be a strong communicator and partner, capable of influencing a team of designers, developers, stakeholders, and executives to achieve value early and often.
* *Leader \-* Group product managers control the destiny of Products for the organization. You must evangelize your team's services and roadmap; distill complex technical concepts into plain language for stakeholders, and advocate for the customer. Ensuring alignment across your group and the Product organization.
* *Partnering \-* Partners with business and technology stakeholders to define and ensure successful delivery of our consumer and associate facing Commerce experiences. Manages stakeholder expectations and provides education to requestors on prioritization, ROI, and roadmap.
* *Staff Management \-* Lead the team of Product Manager, Designers and Analyst, including setting goals and providing guidance and mentorship

**College Board – Learning \& Assessment**

The Editorial team is part of College Board’s Assessment Design and Development (AD\&D) department. We also edit materials and ensure quality control for other College Board programs, such as AP and ACCUPLACER. We work closely with Math and Reading and Writing subject matter experts within AD\&D and other teams across College Board to publish tests and related materials in a variety of formats, both digital and print. As a team, we are in a period of intentional growth and evolution. We are actively refining our processes, strengthening cross\-functional partnerships, and identifying new ways to improve how we work. We value editorial expertise, thoughtful collaboration, and continuous learning and improvement to ensure that we can continue producing work of the highest quality.

 **About the Opportunity**


As a Senior Director, Editorial, you will lead and manage a senior editorial team of five, made up of highly experienced Editors and Graphic/Layout staff, responsible for advancing the quality, consistency, and strategic impact of assessments and publications for the SAT Suite and other College Board programs. You will set and uphold the team’s strategic direction, priorities, standards, and operating procedures, ensuring editorial excellence, efficiency, and alignment to organizational goals. While you will engage in editing selectively to remain connected to the team’s core work, your primary focus will be developing talent through coaching, mentoring, and performance management; strengthening team capability; and driving long\-term planning and major cross\-divisional initiatives. In close partnership with senior leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders, you will champion editorial standards, coordinate strategy across teams, resolve dependencies, and ensure the team’s work delivers meaningful impact for students and other stakeholders.

Copyedit and proofread content for College Board programs such as the SAT Suite, ACCUPLACER, and AP \[5%]

* Copyedit, proofread, and fact check test questions, assessment support materials, and other complex, high\-visibility, or high\-stakes publications in various formats (digital apps, print, etc.), adjusting scope appropriately and modeling advanced editorial judgment
* Apply and interpret College Board and other relevant style guidelines with nuance and consistency to all edited content, especially in ambiguous scenarios
* Provide guidance on substantive editorial questions and resolve escalations requiring leadership oversight
  

Lead and manage the editorial team to drive strategic direction, quality standards, and performance \[55%]

* Shape and communicate the team’s vision, priorities, quality benchmarks, and success metrics in alignment with organizational goals
* Develop, coach, mentor, and manage a talented team of editors and graphic designers through regular feedback, performance management, goal setting, and career development planning
* Monitor team performance using data and feedback, identifying opportunities to improve processes, quality control, and operational effectiveness
* Manage the team’s workload calendar, project timelines, and inter\-departmental coordination efforts, effectively managing competing priorities and ensuring high\-quality, timely editorial results
* Promote a collaborative, constructive, mission\-focused work environment and high\-performing team culture grounded in accountability, continuous improvement, and student\-centered impact
* Allocate resources effectively across programs and initiatives, balancing workload, risk, and strategic priorities
* Establish, refine, and uphold editorial standards, SOPs, and workflow expectations to ensure team consistency, efficiency, quality, and knowledge sharing
* Participate in professional growth opportunities and present relevant information to the editorial team and other stakeholders
* Grow the team through ongoing development, creating stretch opportunities, and building a talent bench
  

Lead long\-term planning and major cross\-divisional initiatives while representing and championing the team across the organization \[40%]

* Design and lead strategic initiatives, evidence\-based experimentation, special projects, and long\-term planning efforts that advance editorial quality, innovation, and operational excellence
* Own outcomes for major team and cross\-divisional projects, including scope, resourcing, timelines, and alignment to organizational goals
* Partner with senior leaders and stakeholders to integrate editorial standards into upstream planning and development processes
* Oversee the development and evolution of shared documentation, templates, workflow standards, and quality benchmarks
* Identify systemic gaps or risks and implement scalable solutions that strengthen efficiency, quality, alignment, and impact
* Champion the adoption of new tools, technologies, and AI\-enabled workflows to improve quality, risk mitigation, and team effectiveness
* Work extensively with cross\-team, cross\-divisional, and cross\-organizational stakeholders to coordinate strategy and resolve dependencies
* Advocate for editorial standards and team priorities in high\-stakes or complex discussions
* Ensure clear communication of editorial rationale, risks, and decisions to senior or leadership\-level audiences
* Promote alignment across assessment development workflows to strengthen overall organizational quality
 **About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in English, journalism, or a related field (master’s degree preferred)
* 10 or more years of copyediting, proofreading, and fact checking experience, preferably in educational publishing, assessment, or technical content
* 3 or more years of people management experience, including coaching, performance management, and talent development
* Demonstrated success setting strategic direction and leading high\-performing teams in a cross\-functional environment
* Deep expertise in grammar, usage, punctuation, and syntax, with comprehensive knowledge of publishing and publications standards and practices and the Chicago Manual of Style
* Proven ability to establish and uphold editorial standards, SOPs, and quality benchmarks at a team or organizational level
* Experience leading large\-scale or cross\-divisional strategic initiatives, with responsibility for outcomes, resourcing, and alignment to organizational priorities
